name: Money Manager (Remove Ads)
description:
“Money Manager” is an optimized application for personal account management. 

Household account management is complicated. But we make it simple by simplifying the things that are complex. The default settings will get you started, and once you get used to it, you can alter the settings according to your needs with the highly flexible and customizable functions available. 

- Super easy and simple to enter data anytime, anywhere. 
- View your spending tendencies graphically. 
- View statistics by simply entering the data. 
- Search and calculator functions. 
- Set up sub-categories and main categories as necessary. 
- Manage all your accounts at once. 
- Use multiple currencies. 
- Check weekly, monthly, and annual statistics. 
- Use the calendar view. 
- Use budget planning features to plan weekly, monthly, and annual budgets. 
- Change the start date of the month. 

※ Applying double entry bookkeeping 
It facilitates efficient account management. Automatically double entry bookkeeping. 

※ PC manager function 
You can view ‘“Money Manager” application using Wi-Fi or 3G. You can edit and sort the data by date, category or account group on the screen of your PC. In addition, you can see fluctuations of your accounts indicated on graphs on your PC. 

※ Budget management function 
You can manage your budget. It shows your budget and expenditures on a graph so you can compare the amount of your expenditures against your budget quickly. 

※ Credit Card / Debit Card management function 
When entering a future payment date, you can see the payment amount and outstanding balance on the accounts page. You can connect your debit card to your accounts so that expenses are automatically recorded under a specific account. 

※ Passcode 
You can specify the desired time lapse before the app requests a passcode. 

※ Automatic money transfer and frequency functions 
You can set up automatic money transfers between your accounts and configure the frequency of those transfers. 

※ Sort expenses by the recipient 
You can sort your expenses by the recipient and view this information graphically. 

※ Payment Profiles 
You can easily enter frequent expenditures by creating payment profiles. 

※ Backup / Restore 
You can backup and restore your data via email, iTunes and iCloud. 

※ Multiple currency support – you can have individual entries in multiple currencies, and configure each account to calculate the total balance in your desired currency.

Subscription pricing and terms:

Money Manager offers auto-renewing monthly subscription at US$2.49/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at US$19.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to the Money Manager Data Sync Service while you maintain an active subscription.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. 
You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase.

https://realbyteapps.com/policy/terms.html

name: Deck-Man: Cassette Player
description:
Deck-Man (formerly referred to as "duo-man") is a playful music player that brings the look, feel, and simplicity of classic portable cassette players to your iPhone Duo.
Turn your phone into a retro cassette player. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases. Just your music, with a little nostalgia.

A Cassette Player Reimagined:
Open your phone, browse your favorite albums as cassette tapes, insert one into the player, and close it to start listening.

The Little Details make that make it fun:
Browse your albums as cassette tapes and load them into your player.
Enjoy familiar play, pause, fast-forward, and rewind controls.
Hear authentic mechanical clicks and cassette sounds recorded from a real portable cassette player.
Enjoy playful interactions inspired by the original cassette-playing experience.

Your Music Your Way
Listen to your favorite albums with support for Apple Music and local music files.

Buy Once.
No ads. No Upsells. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No interruptions.


Deck-Man has been featured by TechCrunch, 9to5Mac, MacRumors, and TechRadar for its imaginative take on the classic portable cassette player.

name: Procreate Pocket
description:
App of the Year winner Procreate Pocket is the most feature-packed and versatile art app ever designed for iPhone.

Procreate Pocket has everything you need to create expressive sketches, gorgeous illustrations, design concepts, enhanced photos, and beautiful animations. Offering hundreds of handmade brushes, a suite of intuitive artistic tools, and an advanced layer system. Work on the couch, on the train, at the beach, or while waiting in line for coffee.
It’s a creative companion in the palm of your hand.

Highlights:

• Sketch ideas when inspiration strikes
• Create engaging photo collages and draw-overs
• Add filters and captivating effects to your images
• Mark-up documents and give feedback on the fly

Breakthrough brushes:

• Packed with hundreds of beautifully crafted brushes
• Organize your brushes into sets and libraries
• Over 100 customizable settings for every brush
• Import and export custom Procreate brushes
• Import Adobe® Photoshop® brushes, and run them faster than Photoshop®

Full-featured layering system:

• Layer your art for precise control over details and composition
• Create Layer Masks and Clipping Masks for non-destructive editing
• Stay organized by combining layers into Groups
• Select multiple layers to move or Transform objects simultaneously
• Access over 25 layer blend modes for industry-grade compositing

Color without compromise:

• Fill your line work with ColorDrop and SwatchDrop
• Disc, Classic, Harmony, Value, and Palette color panels
• Import color profiles for color matching
• Assign Color Dynamics to any brush

Precision design tools:

• Revolutionary QuickShape feature for perfect shapes
• Add vector text to your illustrations
• Easily import all your favorite fonts
• Crop and resize your canvas for perfect composition
• Perspective, Isometric, 2D, and Symmetry visual guides
• Drawing Assist perfects your strokes in real time
• StreamLine and stabilization smooths strokes for beautiful calligraphy and expert inking

Animation and Page Assist

• Easy frame-by-frame animation with customizable onion skinning
• Create storyboards, GIFs, animatics, and simple animations
• Sketch page-by-page concepts, or begin a comic, with Page Assist
• Import, edit, and share PDFs

Dramatic finishing effects:

• Gradient Map — remap your image’s colors with a customizable gradient
• Glitch, Chromatic Aberration, Glow, and Halftone add new dimensions to your work
• Gaussian and Motion Blur filters for depth and movement, or use Sharpen for perfect clarity
• Advanced Noise filter gives you more control for a classic, retro look
• Adjust Hue, Saturation, or Brightness in real time
• Powerful image adjustments including Color Balance, Curves, and HSB
• Bring your art to life with the fun, intuitive, and creative Warp, Symmetry, and Liquify Dynamics

Time-lapse replay

• Relive your creative journey with Procreate’s Time-lapse Replay
• Export your Time-lapse recording in 4K for high-quality video production
• Share a shorter 30-second Time-lapse on your socials

Reference Companion:

• Keep a full canvas or reference image with you at all times
• Paint on your face with AR
• Color-pick right from the reference window

Import assets and share your creations:

• Import or export your art as Adobe® Photoshop® PSD files
• Import Adobe® ASE and ACO Color Palettes
• Import image files such as JPG, PNG, and TIFF
• Export your working files in layered .procreate or PSD file formats
• Share your art as TIFF, transparent PNG, multi-page PDF, web-ready JPEG, and animated GIFs, PNGs, and MP4s

Accessibility

• Global stroke estabilization, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and colour naming

name: iTablaPro
description:
Come sit down for a session with our Tabla Pro. Experience virtuoso, realistic tabla playing, and let the fantastic Tanpura & SwarMandal sound inspire you to greater heights in your own musical journey!
________________________________________

◆◆◆ FEATURED by Apple in Band in Your Hand

And the reviews are in:
***** "REAL Tabla Sound!"
***** "Truly Amazing!"
***** "FANTASTIC app for riyaz"
***** "Best app ever, all I can say is WOW"
***** "Finally a first-class app to replace expensive mediocre hardware"
________________________________________

◆ About iTablaPro ◆
iTablaPro is the first electronic tabla and tanpura that actually sounds like the real thing, ideal for Indian Classical musicians and students. It includes support for all common taals used in Hindustani music, making it the perfect companion for daily riyaz (practice). And the beautiful Tanpura and Swar Mandal create an instant concert atmosphere!

YouTube demo: http://iTablaPro.com
________________________________________

√ SIX fantastic instruments in one app: Tabla, two 5-string Tanpuras, a Sur-Peti (Shruti-Box), Swar Mandal, plus Manjira all controlled by a single set of pitch controls
√ Uses sound samples from actual highest-quality instruments for the most realistic sound
√ 47 taals: Ada Chautaal(14), Ardha Jai(6.5), Ardha Jhaptaal(5), Ardha Shikhar(8.5), Ashta Jhaptaal(8.5), Bhajani(8), Chachar(16), Chartal-ki-Sawari(11), Chautaal(12), Dadra(6), Dakshinatya Rupak(6), Deepchandi(14), Dhamar(14), Ektaal(12), Farodust/Firdost(14), Gajamukha(16), Jai Taal(13), Jat(8), Jhampak(5), Jhaptaal(10), Jhoomra(14), Kalawati(9.5), Keherva(8), Matta Taal(9), Moghuli(7), Neel Taal (7.5), Pancham Sawari(15), Pashto(7), Pauri/Paudi(4), Punjabi / Sitarkhani(16), Rudra Taal(11), Rupak(7),Saatva(7), Sadra(10), Sardha Rupak(10.5), Sasthi(6), Shashanka(5.5), Shikhar(17),Shiva Taal(9), Soolfaak(10), Soolfakhta(5), Sooltaal(10), Sunand(9.5), Teentaal(16), Teevra(7), Tilwada(16), Yamuna(5)
√ Multiple styles for most taals or use the EXPERT MODE for a more interactive experience
√ INTEGRATED AUTO-TUNER: Auto-Tune iTablaPro to your instrument such as harmonium, or use it to tune other instruments
√ MANJIRA: Manjira auto-play support for taals used in bhajans such as Bhajani, Keherva and Dadra
√ AUDIOBUS support: Now you can stream live audio directly to other Audiobus-compatible apps! See http://audiob.us for more information.
√ RECORDING (Optional) add-on now with RECORDING: Hear yourself in the speakers to the background of iTablaPro using the iPhone or headset microphone and record everything (requires external speakers with wired connection or headphones). Additional purchase required.
√ METRONOME: Includes metronome with the most common time signatures!
√ TAP TEMPO: Just tap out a beat on the lower display and watch the app sync the tempo!
√ MIXER: Full-featured mixer to adjust volume & panning of each instrument independently.
√ 7-BAND EQUALIZER: Customizable 7-band equalizer with presets
√ PRESETS: Save your frequently-used combinations as named presets. Includes presets for the 100+ most popular raags. And now you can also export/import presets via email or iTunes File Sharing.
√ BACKGROUND PLAY: Start playing the music and switch to another app or play along with iPod music
√ Includes an option for "Sur" tabla for a more bass tabla sound suitable for vocal music
√ Extremely accurate tempo from 10bpm to 700bpm (depending on the taal)
√ Wide range of pitch from lower A (A2) through upper E (E4) for one and a half octaves of tuning
√ Each taal has different thekas for slow, medium & fast tempos for more natural-sounding accompaniment
√ Displays current matra being played as well as the current divisions (Sam, Taali, Khaali, etc.)
________________________________________

NOTE: The tabla's bayaan sound is very bass-intensive and cannot be full heard through the iPhone/iPod/iPad internal speaker. For best effect, use a speaker dock, external speakers, or high-quality headphones.

name: Lumy
description:
Lumy is a modern sun tracker + outdoor activity planner.

- Need perfect lighting for stunning photos or videos? Done.
- Planning a sunrise walk or sunset hike? Easy.
- Outdoor yoga or a sunshine break? Covered.

Whether you’re chasing golden hour* or keeping an eye on moon phases for a night under the stars, Lumy helps you make the most of natural light.

Now redesigned from the ground up - Lumy feels more personal, purposeful, and in sync with how we live.

Introducing Modes: Switch between profiles like Daily, Photography or Meditation to shape Lumy around your routine. See only what matters to you.

Lumy also supports iOS’s State of Mind feature, offering sun exposure suggestions based on mood entries from the Health app - a gentle nudge to step outdoors and connect with nature.

With seven-day weather forecasts, you can plan ahead with confidence. All sun and moon data is calculated entirely on-device, no tracking, no server requests. Only weather uses the internet.

Lumy works seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and HomePod. One purchase unlocks full access for your family.

Features:
- Modes: Switch profiles to suit your needs... from weekday planning to weekend golden hour.
- Sun + Moon Tracking: Accurate data, solar compass, and future predictions.
- Season Info: Displays both astronomical and meteorological seasons.
- Reminders: Customisable, repeatable notifications.
- Apple Watch: Complications, double-tap support, and Live Activities.
- Widgets + Control Centre: Quick access via Smart Stack and more.
- Interaction Upgrades: Time travel slider, Quick Access Button, fluid animations.
- Visual Feel: Simulated sunlight, shimmering glows, and improved Classic mode.
- Accessibility: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and more.
- Privacy First: Works fully offline (except weather). Your data stays private.
- Localised: Available in French, German, Japanese, and Chinese.

Lumy supports photographers, outdoor enthusiasts, and wellness seekers to stay in rhythm with the sun and moon.

*What’s Golden Hour?
Golden Hour (or Magic Hour) is the short time after sunrise or before sunset when the light is soft, warm, and perfect for taking beautiful photos or videos.

Sun Information Available:
Sunrise, Sunset, First Light, Last Light, Golden Hour, Blue Hour, Astronomical Twilight, Nautical Twilight, Civil Twilight, Solar Noon, Solar Midnight.

Moon Information Available:
Moonrise, Moonset, Altitude, Azimuth, Transit, Transit Elevation, Weekly Moon Phase, Next Full Moon, New Moon, First Quarter, Last Quarter.

Have feedback or suggestions? We'd love to hear from you: hello@waplestuff.com

name: Assyst - Tests and Exams
description:
Assyst helps you create and take tests, prepare for exams and memorize material with flashcards. Open qst, qsz and qsze files, paste a test as plain text or build it in the editor. Tests and results are stored on your device: no sign-up needed, and taking tests, editing and statistics all work offline.

Over a million installs. In development since 2018, the app is translated into dozens of languages and works with files from the Assist desktop program.

How to add a test
- Open a qst, qsz or qsze file from your device, by a link or straight from a messenger or email
- Paste or type a test as text: a question starts with ?, a correct answer with +, a wrong one with -. The text editor checks it as you type and suggests fixes, shows the structure and a preview, and saves your draft automatically
- For lecture notes, a PDF, a Word document or a photo of a page there is a ready prompt: send it to an AI chat with your material and paste the answer into the text editor
- Build a test from scratch in the editor or start from an example

Three modes
- Practice test: each answer is checked right away, followed by a hint if the question has one
- Exam: you see the result only at the end
- Flashcards: the question is on the front, the answer on the back. Recall it, flip the card and mark "I know" or "Don't know" with a swipe or a button; the last mark can be undone. The "Study unknown" deck collects the cards you haven't learned yet, and the "Time to review" banner above the test list reminds you to come back to what you studied

Before you start, pick the questions: all, random, a range, only unanswered, favorites or by category. Shuffle questions and answers and set a time limit. Each filter shows how many questions match it, and the button shows how many go into the session. If none are left, the app tells you which filter to reset. You can also start one session on several tests at once.

After a session
- The number of errors and new correct answers
- Review mistakes: retake only the questions you didn't answer correctly
- Charts: learning progress, attempts per day and by test, passed and failed attempts
- Learning progress for each test in the list: the number and percentage of correct answers, with sorting by progress

View, create and share
- View a test with all answers or only the correct ones, with search, filters and favorite questions
- Six question types: answer selection with one or more correct answers, answer ordering, entering the correct answer as text or a number, and fill in the blanks by typing or choosing
- Question categories, hints, test author and version, several images per question and one per answer
- Export to qst, qsz and qsze or a ZIP archive, share via messengers and email

Who it's for
- School students and college applicants - final school exams, university entrance exams and olympiads
- University and college students - midterms, finals and tests on lectures and textbooks
- Teachers, tutors, parents and training centers - a test maker for class tests, quizzes and trivia
- Companies and HR - employee training, testing and certification, candidate assessment, occupational health and safety exams
- Doctors, lawyers, accountants and other professionals - accreditation, certification and licensing exams
- Driving schools and learner drivers - their own tests for the driving theory exam
- Language learners - words and terms on flashcards

Make it yours: light, dark or system theme, font size and the size of the "Answer / Next" button, automatic move to the next question, keeping the screen on during testing and more.

The core features don't require in-app purchases. PRO removes ads, lifts the editor limits and unlocks "Review mistakes".

name: Plezy: Media Server Client
description:
Plezy is a modern client for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby, built for high-quality playback, effortless discovery, and offline access. Connect multiple servers at once and enjoy your media in one clean, native app—no subscription required.

BROWSE & DISCOVER

- Search across every connected Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby server
- Explore trending, popular, watchlist, and recommendation rows from Plex Discover, Trakt, MyAnimeList, AniList, Simkl, and Seerr

- HDR playback, direct play, and configurable transcode quality
- Switch between media versions with detailed file and stream information
- Full ASS/SSA subtitles with styling controls and online subtitle search
- Auto-play the next episode with skip intro and skip credits
- Chapter navigation, thumbnail scrubbing, playback speed, audio sync, sleep timer, and video zoom
- Picture-in-Picture, loudness normalization, and stereo downmix with center-channel boost
- Resume progress and remembered audio/subtitle choices

MUSIC
- Browse artists, albums, and tracks with rich artwork
- Gapless playback with a reorderable queue, Play Next, and Add to Queue
- Synced lyrics, a persistent mini-player, and sleep timer
- Background playback with lock-screen and media controls
- Offline albums and tracks, plus selectable streaming quality

LIVE TV & DVR

name: Whisper Notes - Speech to Text
description:
Maybe the best offline transcription app — 70,000+ journalists, researchers, and professionals seem to think so.

Turn meetings, lectures, and voice memos into accurate text with speaker labels — fast, 100% offline, on your device. No subscription. One purchase, yours forever.

■ Core Features
- Record voice memos and capture ideas instantly—from the Lock Screen, widgets, Control Center, the Action button, or just say "Hey Siri"
- Import audio and video from any app (WhatsApp, Photos, Voice Memos, etc.), several files at once—even extract subtitles
- Turn meetings, lectures, and interviews into transcripts with speaker labels—see who said what and name each speaker
- Fix a word where you read it: double-tap any paragraph to edit in place
- 101 languages, auto-detected (optimized for English), accurate even in noise and mixed languages—three models (Parakeet, Whisper, SenseVoice), switch freely
- Export as SRT, VTT, or TXT—timestamps and speaker labels included—or auto-save every new transcript to Files or iCloud Drive

■ Privacy & Speed
Because everything runs on your device, there is nothing to upload—and nothing to leak. Turn on airplane mode before you record and leave it on: Whisper Notes works exactly the same. That matters when the recording is an interview, a client meeting, or something you would never put on someone else's server.

Transcribing 5 minutes of audio on iPhone 15: ~18 seconds with Parakeet, ~1 minute with Whisper. SenseVoice is much faster than Whisper and strongest for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Each model has its strengths—choose freely based on language and use case. Older devices are slower but work fine.

■ Honest Pricing
Because transcription runs on your device, we have no server costs—so there is nothing to charge you monthly for. Most similar apps charge $100+/year; we charge once.
No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads.
Not satisfied? Tap Settings → Request Refund.

■ Common Questions

Does it work completely offline?
Yes. Your audio never leaves your device. Works on flights, in remote areas, anywhere.

Can I transcribe WhatsApp voice messages or videos?
Yes. Share or save audio/video from WhatsApp to Whisper Notes and transcribe offline. Perfect for extracting subtitles without uploading to cloud services.

Is there a recording time limit?
Up to 24 hours per recording, and hours-long recordings transcribe on every supported iPhone. Longer recordings just take more time.

Does it support real-time transcription while recording?
Not during recording, but yes during transcription—after you finish recording, you'll see the transcript appear in real-time as it's being generated.

Do you support speaker labels (diarization)?
Yes—fully offline. Tap ⋯ on a note → Detect Speakers, then rename each speaker.

Where is my data stored?
Only on your device. We have zero access. Note: If you delete the app, your recordings are deleted too (because we don't keep secret backups). Please export important files regularly.

Can I summarize a transcript?
Yes — copy it into whichever AI tool you prefer. Whisper Notes itself never uploads anything; your audio and text stay on your device.

What if I switch apps while transcribing?
iOS limits background processing, so transcription pauses and continues automatically when you come back.

Which devices are recommended?
iPhone 12 and newer. Older devices (iPhone 11, iPhone SE 2nd gen) are not recommended—the app will not function properly on these devices.

What languages are supported?
English, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português, Italiano, Nederlands, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Hindi, Arabic, Русский, Türkçe, Polski, Українська, Tiếng Việt, Thai, Tagalog, Bahasa Indonesia, Svenska, Norsk, Dansk, Suomi, Čeština, Greek, Hebrew, Română, Magyar, Persian, Urdu, and 65+ more languages.

■ Contact
Questions? Email support@whispernotes.app
Learn more: whispernotes.app

• Search feature to let find the unit you want and instantly convert it.
• Custom units can be added easily for each category.


Categories Amount can handle: Acceleration, Angles, Area, Clothing (men and women), Cooking, Currency, Data, Density, Electric current, Energy, Flow (mass and volume), Force, Frequency, Fuel Consumption, Illuminance, Length/Distance, Luminance, Metric System, Network speed, Power, Pressure, Radiation, Speed, Temperature, Time, Torque, Typography, Viscosity (dynamic and kinematic), Volume and Weight/Mass. 


TIPS
• Move between screens using swipe gestures.
• Long press any category or unit to see more options.
• Shake the device to change the sorting of category or units (only on iPhone).
• You can change the number directly in the conversion screen by simply tapping it.


ADDITIONAL INFO
To convert currencies is required an internet connection.
Currency and clothing size information are provided only for informational purposes.

If you're going to download Amount, please rate and leave a comment!
And if you have a suggestion don't hesitate to contact me. With your help I can improve Amount even more!

HAPPY COLORING!

name: Flyskyhy
description:
Flyskyhy forms your flight instrument during flight and shows all information you need for that. You get the normal data like altitude, climb rate, ground speed, and glide angle. But it also calculates and shows the current wind direction and strength, very important for your safety.

A moving and rotating map shows your current flying position and flight trail. It indicates where you have gone up (in a thermal), and where you have had faster than normal decline. With that, you can easily find back that thermal that you lost. The map also shows the nearest known landing spots, and whether they are reachable by normal glide, given your current altitude and wind direction.

Integration with Bluetooth varios SensBox, FlyNet, GoFly iPico, XC-Tracer, BlueFlyVario, or SkyDrop gives accurate altitude and lift information. That turns your iPhone into an full-fletched GPS-vario, including vario tones.

The app makes a full log of your flight, that can be analyzed afterwards. Besides normal data like start and landing positions, duration of flight, and an altitude graph of the flight, Flyskyhy also calculates the scoring distances for you. So you can immediately see whether you have broken that FAI triangle record.

Your live location is reported on livetrack24.com or loctome.com if you desire, so anybody can follow your flight while it is happening. If you are flying together with friends, then their location is shown on your map during your flight. So you never have to wonder anymore whether they are in front of or behind you.

The flight display has multiple screens which are all fully configurable. You can move all elements to other spots, delete and add elements, and resize them.

Through in-app purchases, the app also supports airspaces and waypoints.

The app is optimised for paragliding and hang gliders, but can be used with all  kinds of airsports.

Main features during the flight;
• Altitude, climb rate, ground speed, air speed, direction, glide angle and many more
• Wind strength and direction
• Moving map of the flying area
• Spots where you have had lift, great for thermal coring
• Shows whether you can still reach a landing spot with the current altitude and wind
• Live tracking of your flight on livetrack24.com or loctome.com
• Shows live location of your friends during flight

After the flight:
• Full logbook of all your flights
• Basic flight data like start/landing, duration, height difference, distance flown, and many more
• Calculation of 5-points, open triangle, and FAI triangle distances
• Graph of altitude and climb rate
• Signed IGC and KML log files of flights
• Transfer the log to iTunes or send by email
• Upload the flight directly to XContest, ParaglidingForum, DHV-XC, and other Leonardo servers
• Open flight in Google Earth on the iPhone
• Replay the flight and relive it!

By purchasing the Waypoints Extension you get access to:
• A fully zoomable and scrollable map with the waypoints and optimised route. The map also shows start and landing spots, as well as restricted airspaces (with the Airspace Extension)
• Enter new waypoints, either on the map or by specifying the parameters
• Full route support with start time, goal, entry/exit points, etc. 
• Many instruments to guide you along the route
• Visible and audible indication when a waypoint has been reached
• Complete waypoints organiser
• Import and export of various waypoint file formats

By purchasing the Airspace Extension you get access to:
• Airspaces of 30 countries
• Display of airspaces on the map with configurable colors and formats
• Display of your vertical position w.r.t. airspaces
• Visible and audible warnings when approaching and entering an airspace
• Shows local airspaces by touching a spot on the map

Note: a live internet connection is required for live tracking of your and your friends locations
Note: continuous GPS and screen usage makes the battery drain faster than normal

name: BEAKER by THIX
description:
Explore 150 chemicals in a virtual lab in the BEAKER app. Add in chemicals, heat it up, and shake your device to start reactions. Pour them out to clean it up. Or team up with your friends to pour chemicals between each other via AirMix™.

Use virtual Match, Lid and Burner to assist your experiment. Or get the extra five tools - Blender, Cooler, Separator, Filter and Meter to do even more complex operations.

Start (tap or hold on chemicals to add)
- CaO + H2O
- K + H2O (fire)
- Na + H2O (fire)
- Al + Br2 (fire)

Ignite (swipe your finger and hold, like striking a match)
- Ignite Mg, C, Al
- Ignite H2 + O2 (explosion)

Heat Up (swipe in from the lower right corner to turn on Burner)
- Boil Water (H2O)
- Heat Fe + HNO3 (color transformation)

Shake (shake to accelerate reactions)
- CuSO4 + H2O + Mg (color transformation)
- AgNO3 + H2O + Cu (precipitation)
- AgNO3 + H2O + NaCl (precipitation)

AirMix* (nearby BEAKERs will pair automatically)
- Pour Na into Cl2 (fire)
- Pour CH3COOH into NaHCO3 + Blue (bubbles)
- Pour NaCl + H2O into AgNO3 + H2O (precipitation)

* AirMix requires an Internet connection and geolocation services. 

If any chemicals or reactions are missing, please contact us at support@thixlab.com. Your suggestions are greatly valuable to us.

Learn More
http://thixlab.com/beaker.html

Follow Us
Facebook: http://facebook.com/thixlab
Twitter: @thixlab

name: Pocket Director: Remote Camera
description:
Your iPhone's best camera is the one on the back — the one pointing away from you. Pocket Director puts that picture on any other screen you own, and puts the controls there too.

Open a browser on a laptop, tablet or spare phone, scan the code on the iPhone's screen, and you are watching yourself while you film. There is nothing to install on that second device. If it has a browser, it works.


FILM AND WATCH AT THE SAME TIME

• A live view of what the camera sees, on any device on your Wi-Fi
• Start and stop recording from across the room, with an optional 3, 5 or 10 second countdown
• Elapsed time on screen, so you always know how long the take is
• Tap anywhere on the picture to set focus there


CHECK THE TAKE WITHOUT WALKING BACK

• Open Recordings and every take is listed, with its size and when it was shot
• Play any take back in the same browser window you are already watching in
• Download one take, or all of them, to the device you are sitting at
• Auto-download drops each take onto that device the moment you press stop
• Delete a take you don't want, with a confirmation first


A PROMPTER ON THE MONITOR SCREEN

• Paste lyrics, a script or notes and they scroll while you film
• Play, pause and a speed slider, so it moves at your pace
• Drag it anywhere on the screen and resize it to suit your eyeline
• It lives on the second screen only, and never appears in the recording
• Your text and its position are remembered for next time


LIGHT AND COLOUR YOU CAN SET BY HAND

• Light: auto, plus presets such as daylight, cloudy, incandescent, fluorescent and shade
• EV: brighten or darken the exposure yourself when auto gets it wrong
• Lock exposure and lock colour, so the picture stops drifting mid-take
• Flash on or off
• Reset puts light, colour and EV back to automatic in one press


THE REST OF THE CAMERA

• Record in 720p, 1080p or 4K where your iPhone supports it — pick the quality before the take
• Front or back camera
• Zoom that is recorded into the file
• Quality and camera side lock while a take is running, so nothing changes by accident


MONITORING

• Choose the preview size: larger for a laptop, smaller when the signal is weak
• Turn the preview off entirely — recording carries on without it
• Rotate the preview on your screen; the recording keeps its true orientation
• Battery, heat status, free storage and recording time remaining, always on view
• Move the control dock and the status panel wherever suits your screen


PRIVACY THAT NEEDS NO EXPLAINING

• No account, no sign-in, no advertising, no analytics
• No internet required. Your own Wi-Fi is enough, and the iPhone's Personal Hotspot works with no data connection at all
• The picture and the controls stay on your own network
• Every device has to be approved by hand on the iPhone before it sees anything
• Approvals last only while the app is open. Close it and every device is revoked
• Recordings are saved on your iPhone in Files › Pocket Director and stay there


WHAT YOU NEED

• Both devices on the same Wi-Fi, or the second device joined to the iPhone's Personal Hotspot
• A browser on that second device — Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge.
• Pocket Director open on the iPhone while you film. iOS stops the camera when an app goes to the background, so if that happens the take is stopped and saved


Made for anyone who has to be in front of the camera and behind it at the same time: musicians, teachers, makers, presenters, and anyone filming themselves with nobody else in the room.

Found a problem? There is a Report a problem button inside the app.

name: 뭉게 - 텍스트로 스토리 꾸미기
description:
스토리에 붙일 텍스트와 스티커, 적당한 PNG 찾지 말고 직접 만들어요.
모양·색·폰트를 고르면 투명 배경 PNG로 나와요. 사진에서 떼어낸 스티커, 공유받은 스티커도 한곳에 모아 탭 한 번으로 복사. 복사하고 사진, 스토리에 붙여넣으면 끝.

■ 모양 20가지
둥근 사각형, 타원, 캡슐, 구름, 뭉게구름, 폭발, 톱니, 만화 집중선, 반짝이, 하트, 별, 픽셀까지. 꼬리는 없음·뾰족·방울 중에서, 방향도 4가지. 가로·세로 크기는 슬라이더로 자유롭게.

■ 색은 100% 자유
색상 피커, HEX 입력, 그라데이션(선형·방사형), 패턴 8가지, 투명도. 내 사진에서 스포이드로 색을 그대로 찍어올 수도 있어요. 자주 쓰는 색은 내 팔레트에 담아 두고, 안을 사진으로 채우는 것도 돼요.

■ 스타일
테두리 굵기·점선·이중선, 가장자리 번짐, 그림자, 손그림 선.
모두 마음대로 설정 가능해요.

■ 다양한 폰트 사용
굵기·자간·줄 간격·정렬·곡선, 텍스트 테두리·그림자·그라데이션, 단어만 골라 강조까지.
내가 가진 폰트 파일(.ttf/.otf)도 추가할 수 있어요.

■ 텍스트만 내보내기
모양 없이 텍스트만 투명 PNG로. 인스타 기본 텍스트에 없는 한국어 폰트와 흰 외곽선 글자를 스토리에 그대로.

■ 움직이는 텍스트
통통·콩닥·타이핑·팝·흔들. 움직임을 고르면 GIF로 복사돼 스토리에서 그대로 움직여요.

■ 사진 스티커
사진에서 인물·사물만 떼어 투명 스티커로. 스티커 모음 사진은 낱개로 나뉘어 원하는 것만 탭해서 골라요. 손가락으로 문질러 지우거나 되살리고, 경계 흐림·다듬기·색 테두리·그림자까지 입히면 도무송 스티커처럼. 바로 복사하거나 보관함에 담아 두세요.

■ 스티커 보관함
떼어낸 스티커, 사진, 파일, 다른 앱에서 공유받은 스티커를 한곳에. 탭하면 바로 복사, 길게 누르면 꾸미기·손질. 다른 앱 공유 메뉴에서 뭉게를 고르면 그대로 담겨요. 움직이는 GIF도 움직인 채로. 폴더로 나누고 색·무늬·표지 사진으로 꾸밀 수 있어요.

■ 미리 붙여보기
올리기 전에 내 사진 위에 먼저 붙여봐요. 끌어서 옮기고, 두 손가락으로 크기 확인. 저장할 땐 스티커만 깔끔하게.

■ 히스토리·즐겨찾기
사용한 건 자동으로 모아 둬요. 자주 쓰는 조합은 별을 눌러 즐겨찾기로. 다시 열어 고치거나, 길게 눌러 바로 복사.

■ 뭉게가 하는 약속
- 구독 없음. 한 번 결제로 전부.
- 광고 없음, 워터마크 없음.
- 회원가입 없음. 만든 것도, 모아 둔 스티커도 전부 내 기기 안에만.

name: STL Viewer: 3D Print & Mesh
description:
Open your STL file and review the 3D model on iPhone or iPad. STL Viewer brings together model viewing, geometry inspection and technical documentation for 3D printing, prototyping and engineering workflows.

FROM FILE TO MODEL
• Open binary or ASCII STL files.
• Rotate, pan and zoom with multitouch gestures.
• Explore technical views and rendering modes.
• Review model details away from your workstation.

INSPECT WITH PRO
Inspect mesh health, open edges, degenerate faces and geometry. Use surface measurements, dimensions, area, volume and section planes. Assign your file's unit: the STL format does not store units.

DOCUMENT WITH STUDIO
Studio adds technical PDF reports with project information and geometry and mesh summaries, generated on your device.

LOCAL PROCESSING
Model geometry is processed on your device and is not uploaded to our servers. Practical file limits depend on your device's memory and capabilities.

This is a paid app download. Advanced inspection and measurement require Pro; PDF reports require Studio. Subscription features and prices are shown before purchase and can be managed in your Apple account settings. This version's interface is in English.

*THIS IS OFFICIAL LUDO KING® GAME

1 Billion Downloads!

Ludo King is the modern version of the royal game of Parchisi, a game played between Indian kings and queens in ancient times. Roll the dice to play and move your tokens to reach the center of the board. Beat the other players to become the Ludo King. Play this dice game Ludo King. Best casual game in board games.

Ludo has different names in different regions and countries like Fia, Fia-spel (Fia the game), Le Jeu de Dada (The Game of Dada), Non t'arrabbiare, Fia med knuff (Fia with push), Cờ cá ngựa, Uckers, Griniaris, Petits Chevaux (Little Horses), Ki nevet a végén, برسي (Barjis/Barjees). People also misspell Ludo as Loodo, Lido, Lado, Ledo, Leedo, Laado, or Lodo. 

Ludo's versions are Trouble, Sorry, Aeroplane chess, Chopat, Chaupur, Pachisi or Parcheesi.

Features of Ludo King:
•	No internet connection required! Play against the computer.
•	Play with your family and friends through Local and Online Multiplayer.
•	Play with 2 to 6 Players in Local Multiplayer Mode.
•	Invite and challenge your Facebook Friends in a Private Game Room and beat them to become Ludo King.
•	Play with world players and make them your buddies.
•	Private Chat with your Facebook friends & Buddies.
•	Play Snake and Ladders on 7 different gameboards.
•	Simple rules which can be followed by players of all ages.

Play the game of Kings with your family and friends. While the gameplay might seem simple at first, the game is immensely enjoyable and challenging. It’s fun for the whole family; You’ll be playing this one for hours. Try to beat your opponents and compete for the highest scores on the leaderboards.

How to play Ludo King:
The objective of the game is pretty straightforward; each player gets 4 tokens, these tokens must make a full turn of the board and then make it to the finish line. Whoever gets all four tokens to the end first is the winner. However, each move can only be made based on the number decided by casting a six-sided die, and each token can only move out of their home by casting a six. Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player’s token lands on the same square as your token, then your token will automatically be sent back home and you’ll need to roll a six again.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Ludo King now incorporates this classic game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you start on 1 and you have to be the first one to make it to 100. However, you can only move the same number of tiles as the number you roll on a die. As the name suggests, the board is also littered with snakes and ladders. If you land on the same tile as the beginning of a ladder, then you can take the ladder as a shortcut and move on up. But if you land on the mouth of a snake, then down you go to its tail. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King.

name: Kulfi: Games for Couples
description:
You talk to them every day. And still, by 10pm, you're both just trading reels and typing "kya kar rahe ho" for the ninth time. You're not fighting. You're not bored of each other. You're just out of things to do.

Nobody warns you about this part of loving someone in India. A lot of us don't share a city, forget a room. The whole relationship lives inside a phone. Two grey ticks, a few voice notes, one call before bed. So much love stuck inside a very small screen.

Three of us built Kulfi, and we were all in the same spot. Long-term partners we love, who make our day. But once the day's been talked through, it all starts to repeat. What we missed wasn't the conversation, it was their presence. We didn't want to sit alone at night scrolling Instagram. We wanted to be in the same room as them, even when we couldn't. Half our video calls were just silence, nothing left to say. And it wasn't only us. Almost everyone we knew was in the same quiet.

Here's the only promise we care about: no couple on Kulfi should have a boring conversation again. We take that dead late-night chat and turn it into banter, teasing, a bit of fighting, and a lot of "wait, that's not fair."

Kulfi doesn't work like anything you've played. The games run across two phones, yours and theirs, at once. Some split the controls between you, so it's one game, one boat, each holding one half. Mess up your side and you both go down together.

Here's the part we love most. It's made for when you're already on a call. Put Kulfi on while you're on a video or audio call at night, and play straight through it. You're on the call anyway. This is what you do during it.

One house rule. No singles allowed. You invite your partner, send them a code, they punch it in, and you're paired. Till then, the games stay locked. Sounds a bit harsh, but that's the point. Kulfi is a two-person club, and if you're inside it, you've already got the one thing it asks for.

And you won't run dry. We add fresh games every single week. That's a founder promise, not a marketing line. We're trying to keep our own partners entertained, so trust me, the new stuff keeps coming.

Here's some of what's inside:

Pirate Escape
One boat, two captains. One wrong tap and you're both underwater. Stay in sync, or sink.

Snatch the Fries
The plate's between you and there was never enough. Grab fast. Love is conditional now.

Yeet the Spider
Aim, hold your nerve, fling it before the music stops. Don't ask, just throw.

Basketball Rivalry
Twenty seconds on the clock, zero mercy. Outscore them, or hear about it all night.

Four in a Row
Looks innocent. Ends relationships. Drop your coin, block theirs, act like you planned it.

Never Have I Ever
The cards ask, you answer honestly. Some answers you'll wish you could take back.

Who's More Likely To
You each lock in a guess. Then the reveal. Then the argument that lasts an hour.

Pillow Talk
The soft one. A quiet prompt, a real answer, the kind of 2am talk you don't get over text.


Underneath all of it, there's Roadtrip. The more you play, the more miles you and your partner rack up, and your little car moves further across the map. You unlock new cities, crack clues for what's next, and slowly take the road trip you keep saying you'll go on someday. Every other Kulfi couple is on that road too. You can't always meet. You can still go somewhere together.
One honest thing. Nearly every app you live on, Instagram, Snapchat, WhatsApp, was built somewhere else. India has over 200 million couples, and Kulfi is the couples app built in India, for India. We want it in the hands of every couple in the country.

So that's our ask. We built this to solve our own problem and sweated every detail. Download it, play it, and tell us honestly what's broken and what you loved. And please, spread the word. We're a young company, every download counts, and the fastest way Kulfi reaches the couple who needs it is you.

See you on the road,
The founders of Kulfi

name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

name: Arrow Puzzle - Arrows Game
description:
Arrow Puzzle is a relaxing logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

- In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
- Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
- Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others.
- Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.
- If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.
- Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and enjoy the moment when the last arrow leaves and everything falls into place.

Why You'll Love Arrow Puzzle:

• A minimalist arrow game with simple rules and deep strategy—easy to start, satisfying to master.
• Hundreds of handcrafted tap away style puzzles that grow in challenge as you play.
• Daily Challenges—play every day, complete monthly challenges, and collect unique trophies.
• Helpful hints when you need a small nudge to release an arrow and keep the flow going.
• No timer, no pressure—a relaxing escape and a true delight for your mind.
• Clean, calming visuals and smooth animations that keep the focus on puzzle-solving in this tap game.

Play Arrow Puzzle, clear the grid of arrows, and enjoy a rare balance of sharp focus and deep relaxation.

Our array of Number Games like 2048 and 2248 will get your neurons firing. Engage in these numeric challenges and strive to hit the highest scores. They're perfect for keeping your mind sharp, and they're addictive, too! You'll find yourself coming back to beat your own scores time and again.
Word Games are a great way to expand your vocabulary and language skills. With word guess and word finder, you'll embark on an adventure through a maze of letters, uncovering hidden words, and building your own word lists. It's a fun way to learn new words, and the challenge will keep you hooked for hours.

Feel the adrenaline rush with our Thrilling Challenges. Step into the mind-bending world of Minesweeper, where every click could be your last. Or play Hangman, where you'll rack your brains to guess the right letters before time runs out.

We've brought back some of your favorite Classic Memory Games. Engage your brain in our sound memory game, a modern twist on the classic 'Simon Says'. For a bit of nostalgia, we've also included the much-loved game of Snake.

For the serious strategists and thinkers out there, our Mind Benders section is perfect. Chess and Chess puzzles will provide a mental workout and fun brain training. Hone your strategic skills, and take on the challenge to become the grandmaster.

Our Two-Player Games offer the perfect opportunity for a friendly showdown. Go head-to-head with AI in games like Checkers, Pool, or Tic Tac Toe, even when you're in airplane mode. It's fun gaming action whenever you want, wherever you are! See if your friends can do better!

name: Telegram Messenger
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: RailOne
description:
RailOne: Your All-in-One App by Indian Railways
RailOne is a comprehensive app developed by Indian Railways, designed to consolidate all public-facing services into a single, user-friendly platform. By integrating multiple functionalities into one app, RailOne simplifies the travel experience with a seamless single sign-on (SSO) system. Whether you’re planning a trip, booking tickets, or seeking additional services during your journey, RailOne is your ultimate travel companion. 

Key Features:
Plan and Book Tickets: Effortlessly plan journeys, search for trains, and book reserved or unreserved tickets through the app. This consolidation reduces the need for multiple platforms, streamlining the booking process.
- My- Bookings: This functionality enables the users to check the details and history information of both booked and canceled tickets (unreserved and reserved) at the same platform. User interface presents the filtering  functionality as per user’s preference based on duration and transaction type.
-You: This functionality enables users to view profile details and edit if needed. Also shows status of profile completion. Gives access for changing password, enabling/disabling biometric. Users can also verify email, edit their name (can be done only once) and delete account. These options are available under My Account Tab. User can also Add money to his R-wallet.
Real-time Train Tracking: Track your train in real-time with live updates on delays, expected arrival times, and other critical information, keeping you informed and helping you adjust your plans.

Coach Position Finder: Locate your coach’s position on the platform easily, making the boarding process smoother and more convenient.

Order Food on the Go: Place food orders from partner vendors while on board, ensuring fresh and timely meals during your journey.

Rail Madad: Use the Rail Madad feature to raise and track complaints or feedback directly with Indian Railways for quick resolution.

Refund Requests: Simplify the process of requesting refunds for canceled or missed journeys through the app.

Multilingual Support: Access the app in multiple languages, catering to India’s diverse population and enhancing accessibility.

R-Wallet Integration: Utilize R-Wallet, a digital wallet integrated into the app, for secure and convenient payments for various services.

The app is developed by CRIS (Centre for Railway Information Systems), an organization under the Ministry of Railways. CRIS combines skilled IT professionals with experienced railway personnel to design, develop, and maintain critical software systems for Indian Railways. Key systems developed by CRIS include:

Reserved Ticketing System: Efficiently manages millions of long-distance seat bookings.
Unreserved Ticketing System: Facilitates easy ticketing for short-distance journeys.
Train Search and Tracking: Offers real-time train search and tracking features.
Coach Position Finder: Enhances the boarding process by helping passengers find their coach.
Rail Madad: Manages grievances and feedback effectively.
Food Ordering System: Allows passengers to order food from partner vendors.
Refund Systems: Processes refunds smoothly for booking errors and cancellations.
CRIS continues to lead in innovation, developing integrated solutions that make travel more efficient. The partnership between CRIS and Indian Railways has been instrumental in modernizing railway infrastructure and enhancing passenger services through advanced technology. RailOne embodies this digital evolution, making train travel smarter, more comfortable, and more accessible. With ongoing developments in RailOne and CRIS’s IT systems, Indian Railways aims to provide an exceptional travel experience, leveraging technology to simplify every aspect of your journey.

name: Super Farming Boy
description:
** Appstore Awards - Apple TV App of the Year 2025 - Finalist **
** PocketGamer Awards 2025 - Best Indie Game - Finalist **
** Gamescom Latam 2025 - Best Latam Game - Finalist **

Super Farming Boy™ is an exciting mix of ACTION, PUZZLE, and FARMING SIM, heavily relying on CHAIN REACTIONS and COMBOS.      

Story
In Super Farming Boy™, you play as Super, whose mom and friends have been captured by your evil nemesis, KORPO®©TM, who unlawfully hires you to work on your own land, taxing all proceeds for himself! Now, with your friends and mom up for sale, you must harvest your way through challenging adventures, saving enough to buy your mom and friends back!

Gameplay Mechanics
In Super Farming Boy™, there are no tools because you are the tool. With the simple push of a button, you can transform into a shovel, a hammer, a pickaxe, a watering can, and more! Super Farming Boy™ can even FLY! The game's central mechanic revolves around chain reactions and combos. The magical seed creatures in this world, once harvested, trigger specific chain-reaction effects that enable you to optimize your farm in ways never seen before in a farming game. These chain reaction and combo powers also serve as your means of defense against creatures, help optimize your daily stamina usage, and facilitate various actions such as chopping down trees, demolishing boulders, removing weeds, collecting items, defeating bosses, and much more! Explore whimsical weathers and extraordinarily unusual seasons, such as Radioactive Season, Timewarp Season, and Volcanic Season. There's even a season set underwater! Super Farming Boy™ has been meticulously designed with touch controls in mind. The gameplay is incredibly intuitive: everything is drag-and-droppable and supports both classic joystick controllers (XBOX, Bluetooth, PS, Joycon, Switch Pro Controllers), keyboard, and touch simultaneously!

Features

Superhero abilities
Super Farming Boy™ has the ability to walk, run, and even fly! Additionally, he can transform into any tool with a simple push or tap of a button—be it a shovel, pickaxe, axe, or hammer, and more!

Chain reaction and combos
Optimize your farm by harvesting a single crop and witnessing the chain and combo effects efficiently harvest your entire farm at once. However, meticulous and strategic planning in your planting efforts is essential!

Unlock & upgrade supertools
All SuperTools and powers in Super Farming Boy™ come in the form of old-school superhero trading cards. Unlock, collect and upgrade them all!

Unusual seasons to discover
Explore a plethora of seasons in Super Farming Boy™, including Spring, Winteria, Volcanic, Radioactive, Underwater (coming soon), and Timewarp (coming soon).

Idle helpers to collect
Rescue all your friend-pets by purchasing them back from Korpo™®©! Each pet comes with a unique idle mechanic to help automate your farm, like auto-watering, auto-hammering, and more.

No inventory management
Super Farming Boy™ eliminates the need for inventory management. All seeds and idle helpers are creatures that follow you around wherever you go, avoiding the hassle of an ever-filling inventory!

Beauty up and customize it all
Personalize your BlobHouse with fantastic beauty items such as bedside tables, rugs, and beds! Your home will be uniquely yours and look amazing with your creative touch.

Boss fights... in a farming game?
Utilize your crops' combo and chain reaction powers to defend your farm against evil creatures like pests and seasonal bosses!

Touch controls that are actually good
Enjoy very intuitive touch controls—drag and drop every item in the game! Including NPCs, seeds, idle helpers, and Super Farming Boy™ himself!. Alternatively, play with your favorite XBOX/PS or Bluetooth controller.
