name: Toastie: grilled cheese game
description:
Toastie turns your iPhone into a toaster.

Make a grilled cheese sandwich from scratch: butter the bread, lay on the cheese and fillings, and put it in the toaster. Close the lid and it starts toasting in real time. Open it too early and the cheese hasn't melted; leave it too long and it burns. Take it out at the right moment and you get a perfect toastie.

HOW IT WORKS
• Butter the bread with your finger: cover the slice, on the right side.
• Drag the cheese and fillings onto the bread and spread them out.
• Hurry: customers are waiting. You have 15 seconds to build each order.
• Press GRILL, close the lid, and wait for the sizzle.
• Open it to check, or trust your timing, then serve.
• Every sandwich gets a score card: recipe, plating, toasting and prep time. Five stars turn it gold.
• Four stars unlock the next recipe.

10 RECIPES
From a Classic Grilled Cheese and Cheese & Tomato to Brie & Cranberry, Kimchi, Mushroom & Taleggio, Pesto, Tomato & Gruyère and The Works. White sandwich loaf, sourdough and brioche, 14 real ingredients, each with its own recipe card.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Toastie plays on any iPhone and iPad. On iPhone Duo, the phone itself becomes the toaster: fold it shut to close the lid, and open it to see how your sandwich is doing.

ALSO
• Share your toastie to Instagram Stories or X.
• Your progress syncs with iCloud across your devices.
• Game Center leaderboard and achievements.
• No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases. Pay once.

The world's most expensive toaster.

name: Game Dealers
description:
Start with a small game shop and build it into a successful business. During the day, different customers come into your store. Some want to sell their old games, while others are searching for something special to add to their collection. Your goal is to make smart deals, buy at the right price, and sell for a profit.

Each game is different. Some are easy to find, while others are much rarer and more valuable. The condition of the box and the disc also matters, so checking every item carefully is an important part of the job. Before you make a deal, you need to look at the details, consider the customer’s offer, and decide whether it is worth making a counteroffer. A single good negotiation can make a big difference.

As you earn more money, your shop begins to grow. You can improve your business, handle better trades, and build a stronger collection over time. The game combines second-hand game trading with simple negotiation mechanics, detailed item conditions, and a cozy retro pixel art style to create a satisfying shop management experience.

Grow your store, make better deals, collect great games, and become a true game dealer.

name: RFS - Real Flight Simulator
description:
EXPERIENCE THE ULTIMATE FLIGHT SIMULATOR ON YOUR MOBILE DEVICE!

Immerse yourself in the captivating world of aviation with RFS - Real Flight Simulator. Our cutting-edge flight simulation technology allows you to experience the thrill of being a pro pilot from your device. Whether you want realistic airplane games or a professional flight simulator, RFS delivers an unparalleled journey.

FLY NOW, ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD!

Learn to take off, land, and complete full flights in a global flight simulation environment. Explore aircraft with 3D live cockpits, visit 30 HD airports, and navigate 500 SD airports. Personalize instruments, use automatic flight plans, and experience the finest detail in this global flight simulator. Master your skills with our pilot tutorials and become a master of flight simulation!
Manual/Tutorial: Real Flight Simulator Wiki
UNLOCK THE FULL REAL FLIGHT SIMULATOR EXPERIENCE
Choose the subscription that fits: monthly, six-month, or yearly. Join virtual aviators and access premium features in the most advanced airplane simulator and flight simulator available on the App Store.

BUCKLE UP AND BECOME A REAL PILOT!

As a pro pilot in our flight simulator, you will enjoy a vast array of features for the ultimate flight simulation:
• 60+ AIRPLANE MODELS: Take command of airplane models with realistic 3D cockpits and authentic lighting. Experience pilot systems and instruments in every flight.
• 1900+ HD AIRPORTS: Land your airplane at 3D airports featuring realistic buildings, vehicles, and authentic ground procedures. This is the most detailed airport simulation in a mobile flight simulator.
• REAL-TIME FLIGHTS & WEATHER: Join 40,000+ real-time flights daily with live air traffic at global hubs. Experience real-time weather that challenges your pilot skills in this realistic flight simulator.
• DETAILED CHECKLISTS: Follow authentic pilot procedures for takeoff and landing to fully immerse yourself in the flight simulation.
• ADVANCED GROUND SYSTEMS: Interact with refueling trucks, passenger vehicles, and follow-me cars upon landing your airplane.
• ADVANCED FLIGHT PLANNING: Customize real-time weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots for a connected flight simulation community.
• AUTOPILOT & ASSISTED LANDING: Utilize precise autopilot and our Automatic Landing System for long-haul airplane missions.
• REALISTIC SATELLITE SCENERY: Explore the world with high-definition satellite terrain and height maps in stunning 3D. This is global flight simulation at its finest.

ENGAGE IN GLOBAL MULTIPLAYER MODES

• Join hundreds of other pilots and fly together in any part of the world.
• Chat with fellow multiplayer pilots, participate in weekly events, and join Virtual Airlines (VA) to earn Flight Points. RFS is the premier multiplayer flight simulator.

ATC MODE: BECOME AN AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLER

• ATC GAME MODE: Organize aircraft traffic, give instructions, and guide planes to fly safely.
• Enjoy interactive multi-voice ATC procedures and communications. Experience the dual role of pilot and controller in one simulation.

CREATE AND SHARE YOUR AVIATION PASSION

• CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLANE: Design your own airplane liveries and share them globally.
• DESIGN YOUR AIRPORT: Model your favorite HD airport, and watch other pilots take off from your creation in the flight simulator.
• PLANE SPOTTING: Capture your favorite planes. Experience city lights at night and the ethereal play of light and clouds during sunrise and sunset.
• Join the Real Flight Simulator community, discover new flight routes, and interact with aviation enthusiasts.

REAL-TIME SIMULATION REQUIREMENTS

Internet Connection is required for the full scope of aviation experiences and multiplayer features.

GET READY TO SOAR THE SKIES!

Buckle up and become a Real Pilot in RFS - Real Flight Simulator!

TERMS OF USE: https://www.rortos.com/terms-of-use/
Support: rfs@rortos.com

name: Sifu
description:
Embark on a path of revenge in Sifu, the critically acclaimed third-person brawler renowned for its tight Kung Fu combat and cinematic martial arts action, now fully adapted for mobile.

Is one life enough to know Kung Fu?
Hunt down your family's assassins, one against all. You have no allies, countless enemies, and a mysterious amulet that brings you back to life every time you die. Yet be warned: your secret weapon comes with a hefty price to pay: aging and its consequences.

Trial by Fire
Your enemies don't wait their turn, and they don't broadcast their intent. Dodge, parry, strike, use combos, and be like water making its way through captivating environments. Learn to master your art as you fight through the underbelly of a nightclub, scramble through a refined gallery to avoid being surrounded, and navigate a towering office building in pursuit of revenge.
 
Adaptation is Survival
Careful positioning and clever use of the environment are key to your survival. Use everything at your disposal: throwable objects, makeshift weapons, windows, and ledges. The odds are stacked against you, and you will be offered no mercy.

Training Never Ends
Kung Fu is mastery through practice, a path for both the body and the mind. Learn from your errors, unlock unique skills, and find the strength within yourself to master the devastating techniques of Pak-Mei Kung Fu.

Adapted for Mobile
Experience Sifu on the go with new touch controls designed specifically for mobile devices, enhanced contextual interactions, a reworked camera system, and full controller support. Fight your way through the complete story campaign, optimised for mobile play.

name: Hitman Sniper
description:
BECOME THE ULTIMATE SILENT ASSASSIN
Step into the shoes of Agent 47 in Hitman: Sniper and discover the most compelling sniper experience on mobile.
 
TACTICAL MISSIONS IN MONTENEGRO
Hone your strategic skills and orchestrate the perfect assassination.
 
ACTION ZOMBIE CHALLENGE IN DEATH VALLEY
Prepare for non-stop action in a true test of your accuracy and speed of execution.
 
MORE THAN 150 MISSIONS AND 11 DIFFERENT CONTRACTS
Improve your strategy for the perfect assassination as you uncover secrets and subterfuges.

17 UNIQUE WEAPONS
Eliminate targets, collect weapon parts and complete blueprints to unlock the most powerful rifles.

COMPETE AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS TO DOMINATE THE LEADERBOARD
Boost your score and climb up the ranks to become the world's finest silent assassin.


Hitman: Sniper is memory intensive. Devices such as iPad 2, iPad Mini, iPhone 4S and iPod Touch 5th Generation will suffer from occasional dips in performance and will not support Everyplay.

name: Wreckfest
description:
Burn rubber and shred metal in the ultimate driving playground!

Wreckfest is jam-packed with upgrade and customization options. Whether you are preparing for your next demolition derby with reinforced bumpers, roll cages, side protectors and much more, or setting your car up for a banger race with engine performance parts like air filters, camshafts, fuel systems, etc., Wreckfest is shaping up to be the best combative motorsport game out there. 

• Unique Racing Experience – Exhilarating no-rules racing action with defining, once-in-a-lifetime moments that can be achieved only with a true-to-life physics simulation. Witness insane neck-to-neck fighting on high-speed circuits, face total destruction madness on crazy courses with intersections and oncoming traffic, or go for demolition dominance in derby arenas.

• Awesome Cars – Our cars are old, banged up, patched together... They ooze style and character! From old American heavy-hitters to agile Europeans and fun Asians, you won’t find anything like this in other games. 

• Meaningful Customization – Change not only the look of your cars but also upgrade their body armor – Reinforce them with heavy iron that protects you from damage, but also adds weight, which impacts the cars handling. Modify your car to make a robust tank or a fragile but lightning-fast rocket, or anything in between!

• Multiplayer – Wreck your friends in local multiplayer and take racing to the limit while chasing for demolition dominance!

• Challenge modes – Have hilarious fun with crop harvesters, lawn mowers, school buses, three-wheelers and much more! 

• Career Mode – Battle for championships, earn experience, unlock new upgrades and cars, and become the all-time Wreckfest champion!

© www.handy-games.com GmbH

name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
description:
The Kingdom has fallen. Time has turned back. And the only way to save the future is to defend the past. Welcome to Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis
The legendary tower defense saga by Ironhide Game Studio returns. Travel back to the dawn of Linirea, recruit the heroes who built the kingdom, and stop a young Vez'nan before darkness takes hold.

A PREQUEL, REWRITTEN
Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands at a time when legends were just beginning. Walk through known battlefields and uncover the moment everything went wrong.

15 TOWERS, ENDLESS STRATEGIES
Archers, mages, barracks, artillery, every tower has a specialty, and the real game is the synergy between them. Build your defense, lock the lane, watch the wave break.

12 LEGENDARY HEROES
Take two heroes into each battle and combine their abilities. Familiar Linirean champions return to your side, fighting beside you like the old days, and a few faces you're about to meet for the first time.

9 POWERFUL SPELLS
Equip a loadout of spells and unleash them at the moment that matters, meteor showers, powerful reinforcements, battlefield-wide control. Save them for the bosses. You'll need them!

18 HANDCRAFTED CAMPAIGN STAGES
Cross three landscapes of early Linirea, from the Citadel to the Stormcloud Depths and the far away lands of Arcania. Face 40+ enemies across 5 distinct races, and 6 colossal bosses standing between you and the future.

THE PLOT THICKENS. 
More lore, more callbacks, and the Kingdom Rush humor that made you fall in love with Linirea in the first place.

GAME MODES, ACHIEVEMENTS, AND EASTER EGGS
For the ones who like to 100% everything: 50+ achievements, harder modes if you're feeling brave, and easter eggs we had way too much fun hiding.

OFFLINE, ANYWHERE
Defend the realm on the bus, on a plane, in a tower of your own. No connection required.
Defend the past to change the future. Join the millions of players who have rallied to Linirea since 2011.

name: Shadow Fight 2 Special Edition
description:
** New story chapter! **
** No Ads! **
** No energy! **

The best fighting series on mobile has returned and become even more SPECIAL - Shadow Fight 2 Special Edition!! 

Now it's your turn to meet Titan in person and put an end to his terror. Walk through the Gates of Shadows into the dangerous world full of memorable fights and brave heroes. These lands are waiting for a risky adventurer to appear and save them from the oppression of a sinister invader from another dimension! Discover a thrilling mix of two world's most popular game genres - Fighting & RPG. Gather a huge arsenal of lethal weapons, combine your gear and upgrade dozens of skills and moves!

- No Ads!
- No energy restoring. Jump into the fray anytime and anywhere you want!
- Unveil a truth behind Sensei's past in a whole new story chapter!
- Complete the story mode without grinding!
- Equip yourself with a huge amount of weapons and armor. Get a lot of gems through battles and make your arsenal even more larger!
- Travel across 7 distinct provinces and force to terrify Titan himself!
- Simple controls is designed for touch screen usage. Shadow Fight 2 is easy to play but hard to master!
- Astonishing animations and unique design!

You must have an internet connection for a verification check (only for the first launch).

name: Black Border 2
description:
Inspect papers, prevent smuggling—keep the border safe or profit from corruption.

Ready to become a Border Police Officer? Step into the world of Black Border 2: Border Patrol Simulator and experience the intense pressure of national security. As a Customs Officer, your duty is to protect the nation from illegal smuggling. Inspect passports, scrutinize documents, and use advanced tools to make life-or-death decisions in this gripping police simulator game.

Take on the duty of a Border Patrol Agent and protect your nation's borders. Your role is crucial:

Document Inspection: Meticulously check passports, permits, and papers to approve or reject entrants.

Advanced Tools: Utilize X-ray scanners to reveal hidden items and weigh stations to check vehicle legitimacy.

Canine Unit: Deploy your loyal service dog to sniff out concealed contraband and uncover secrets.

Strategic Decisions: Every choice you make impacts the safety of your country.

NEW FEATURES in Black Border 2:

Document Inspection: Meticulously check passports and permits to approve or reject entrants as a customs officer.

Endless Mode: Test your border patrol skills in a nonstop, challenging experience.

Bus Arrivals: Manage large buses and check every passenger's documents carefully.

Advanced Scanning: Utilize new X-ray scanners to reveal hidden items and contraband.

Weigh Stations: Ensure vehicle weights match their records, a key part of your police duty.

Canine Unit: Your faithful service dog is now a crucial partner in finding hidden contraband.

Each day as a border inspector brings new challenges that will push your customs police skills to the limit. Are you ready to face the pressure and become a true hero of national security?

Download Black Border 2 today and get ready to defend the nation!

name: Townscaper
description:
Build quaint island towns with curvy streets. Build small hamlets, soaring cathedrals, canal networks, or sky cities on stilts. Block by block.

No goal. No real gameplay. Just plenty of building and plenty of beauty. That's it.

Townscaper is an experimental passion project. More of a toy than a game. Pick colors from the palette, plop down colored blocks of house on the irregular grid, and watch Townscaper's underlying algorithm automatically turn those blocks into cute little houses, arches, stairways, bridges and lush backyards, depending on their configuration.

name: Poppy Playtime Chapter 1
description:
You must stay alive in this horror/puzzle adventure. Try to survive the vengeful toys waiting for you in the abandoned toy factory. Use your GrabPack to hack electrical circuits or nab anything from afar. Explore the mysterious facility... and don't get caught.


---Welcome to Playtime Co.!---
Playtime Co. was once the king of the toy manufacturing industry... until everybody inside of the factory one day disappeared into thin air. Now, years later, you must explore the abandoned factory and uncover the truth.

---The Toys---
The toys of Playtime Co. are a lively bunch! From Bot to Huggy, Catbee to Poppy, Playtime does it all! As long as you're at Playtime Co., why not pay the toys a little visit? You might just make a few friends...

---The GrabPack---
This amazing GrabPack is a wearable backpack, accompanied by 2 artificial hands attached via steel wire. With this handy, state-of-the-art tool, there's no limit to what Playtime Co. employees can accomplish! The following list of features should help to show you what the GrabPack has to offer.

- The hands' powerful grip allows for movement of heavy objects with ease!
- A lengthy and flexible wire gives any employee the ability to reach whatever they may need, no matter the distance!
- The steel wire makes conducting electricity a breeze!

The only limit is the length of your GrabPack's wire.



Won't you stick around? There's lots of fun in store for you. It's almost Playtime...

name: Hue Rings
description:
Hue Rings is a minimal puzzle game with a simple premise: merge rings on a 5×5 grid into a single ring. Easy to learn in seconds, yet challenging enough to keep you thinking for hours — with a satisfying pop every time rings merge.

The rules are simple:
• Tap an empty slot that has 2+ matching rings adjacent to it.
• The rings merge together into one.
• Merge all rings into one to win.
• That's it! Now try to master it.

What starts simple becomes beautifully complex:
• Portals teleport rings across the board.
• Converters flip ring colors mid-puzzle.
• Black Holes strategically remove rings.
• Magnets pull rings in specific directions.
• Wildcards match any color.
• Blockers add spatial constraints.

Why you'll love it:
• Thousands of puzzles that gradually introduce new mechanics.
• Fresh experience every time: each playthrough presents a different set of levels.
• Clean, minimal interface that stays out of your way.
• Dynamic color themes that adapt as you play.
• Undo system to experiment with strategies.
• Hint system when you need a nudge.
• Relaxing ambient music.
• No timers, no pressure. Just pure puzzle solving.

Every level is solvable, but finding the solution requires careful planning. The minimal design keeps you focused on what matters: the puzzle itself.

name: London Train!
description:
Run London Trains!
Operate the London Underground, overground lines and National Rails!

You can now operate the London Underground and overground lines, as well as National Rail intercity trains connecting London with other cities! This game is packed with the latest information on British railways!

The rules are the same as "Tokyo Train! 4." British railways have publicly operated tracks, while electric trains are either privately or publicly operated. This game recreates the scene of trains from many different railway companies running on the same tracks. Therefore, be aware that rival trains may also run on the same tracks. Also, unprofitable trains are subsidized, so try to achieve this.

- For Railway Commanders
As a train dispatcher, dispatch various trains, including regional and intercity trains, to transport passengers.

- Game Objective
Transport passengers, collect fares, and aim for maximum operating profits!

Profit Calculation Formula
① Variable Fare - ② Travel Time x ③ Number of Passengers - ④ Departure Cost = ⑤ Operating Profit

① Variable Fare:
Receive a fare when your train transports passengers to their destination. The fare decreases over time. The fares increase the further to the right a station is located.

② Journey Time:
The journey time is displayed above the moving train. The fare you receive when the train transports a passenger to their destination is deducted from the journey time. The faster you transport passengers, the shorter the journey time.

③ Number of Passengers:
Each station displays the number of passengers it is serving.

④ Departure Cost:
A departure cost is deducted when the train departs.
The departure cost is displayed below the departure button.

⑤ Operating Profit:
This is the goal of the game. Aim for great results!

・Controls
Controls are very simple.
Just depart the train at the perfect time.
You can operate up to five types of trains.

・Plenty of content
More than 30 route maps are available!
You can also compete with others using the ranking feature.

・Timetable Feature
As with Train Dispatcher! 4, you can view the results of your train operations on a timetable.
In addition to pursuing operational profits, you can also enjoy browsing the beautiful timetable.

・Approximately 180MB of storage space
It takes up little storage space and doesn't require heavy processing, so it's compatible with older devices.
Each game takes just three minutes, so you can enjoy it casually.

・No ads, no in-app purchases
There are no in-app purchases. No ads.
There's nothing to interfere with your train operations. Just focus on the game.
Children can enjoy it safely too.
Share your operation results and timetables with other railfans.

name: SUMEE!
description:
SUMEE! turns your iPhone into a complete portable gaming system for organizing, customizing, emulating, and enjoying compatible retro games all in one place.

Designed for both handheld and big-screen play, SUMEE! is especially focused on users who play with a game controller and connect their iPhone to an external display via HDMI or AirPlay.

SUMEE! supports compatible files from multiple classic systems, including:

Nintendo:
• Wii
• Nintendo GameCube
• Nintendo 3DS
• Nintendo DS/DSi
• Nintendo 64
• SNES
• NES
• Game Boy Advance

Sony:
• PlayStation / PSX
• PSP

Sega:
• Sega Genesis

Native Experiences in SUMEE!:

SUMEE! also offers specially adapted experiences for select games, with interfaces, controls, and features designed specifically for each one.

• Mario Kart
• The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
• Super Mario Galaxy
• Halo: Combat Evolved

To use these experiences, compatible files from a legally obtained copy of the game are required. SUMEE! does not include or distribute these games or their copyrighted game files.

Main Features:

• Dock Mode for big-screen gaming with a console-like experience
• Game controller support
• External display support via HDMI and AirPlay
• Modern interface inspired by classic handheld devices
• Game launcher and library organization
• USB support for importing your own files
• iCloud support for compatible data
• RetroAchievements support
• Save files and save states
• Customizable touch controls
• Skins, themes, and visual customization options
• Performance tools for a smoother experience
• Local multiplayer features for compatible systems
• Split-screen support for two players in compatible games
• Wi-Fi support for compatible DS/DSi local play
• GBA Link support for compatible local connectivity features
• PictoMee, an integrated social space for sharing posts
• User profiles, friends, and social interactions
• Direct messages between users
• Account options and user safety tools

SUMEE! does not include games, ROMs, BIOS files, or copyrighted content. Users are responsible for importing only files they legally own or have the right to use.

SUMEE! is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or associated with Nintendo, Sony, PlayStation, Sega, RetroAchievements, Apple, AirPlay, or any other console manufacturer, game publisher, service provider, or trademark owner.

PictoMee is intended for users aged 16 and older. Users should review and follow PictoMee's Terms and Community Guidelines before using social features.

Built for users who enjoy retro experiences, compatible emulation, customization, achievements, social connectivity, portable gaming, and a console-like big-screen gaming experience.

name: EvoCreo2 Catch & Tame Monsters
description:
Join millions of players in this pocket monster game sequel
Embark on an epic adventure in EvoCreo 2, the ultimate monster-catching RPG set in the captivating world of Shoru. Immerse yourself in a land teeming with mythical creatures called Creo. For thousands of years, these collectible monsters have roamed the lands, their origins and evolution shrouded in mystery. Do you have what it takes to unravel the secrets of the Creo and become a legendary Evoking Master Trainer?

Uncover a Compelling Adventure Game
Begin your role playing game (RPG) journey as a new recruit in the Shoru Police Academy. Creo Monsters are disappearing, and it's your mission to uncover the truth behind these mysterious events. But there's more to the story than meets the eye in this monster game — dark plots are brewing, and your skills will be put to the test. Along the way, assist the citizens of Shoru by completing over 50 engaging missions, building alliances, and discovering hidden treasures.

Capture and Train Over 300 Monsters
Love monster-collecting games? Build your RPG dream team of Creo in this open-world role playing game. Hunt rare and legendary monsters, each available in unique alternate colors. With over 300 unique monsters to capture, evolve, and train, you’ll have endless possibilities to customize your strategy in pocket monster games. Create powerful combinations and lead your Creo to victory in thrilling turn-based battles.

Explore this monster adventure game
Experience more than 30 hours of offline and online rpg gameplay as you dive into a richly detailed open world. From dense forests to mysterious caves and bustling towns, the continent of Shoru is filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Adventure through diverse environments, complete challenging quests, and uncover hidden paths to legendary treasures. Explore 2 more biomes in this sequel like the desert and find many monsters on the way of your adventure. 

Master a deep and strategic RPG battle system as a monster trainer & hunter
Prepare for trainer battles with a highly customizable system. Equip your Creo with items and unlock over 100 unique traits to enhance their abilities. Train your Creo to learn and master over 200 moves, which you can swap anytime to adapt to new challenges. Face fierce opponents, manage elemental weaknesses, and use your tactical skills to gain the upper hand. Can you become a pocket monster master trainer?

Prove Yourself as the Ultimate Master Trainer
Challenge the strongest monster trainers across Shoru and rise through the ranks in this paid role playing game. Compete in the prestigious Coliseum, where only the best monster trainers are crowned as champions. Will you conquer every rpg battle and claim the title of Evoking Master Trainer?

Key Features:
- Sequel of one of the top paid role playing games worldwide
- 300+ collectible monsters to capture, train, and evolve.
- No level cap on your monsters - engaging endgame!
- A sprawling open world with 30+ hours of offline & online gameplay.
- Engaging turn-based battles with deep strategy elements.
- Hundreds of moves and traits to customize your Creo.
- Over 50 missions packed with adventure and rewards.
- Offline play—no internet required to enjoy the game.
- Stunning pixel art visuals reminiscent of classic monster RPGs.

Why Players Love EvoCreo 2:
Fans of Monster games and monster trainer RPGs will feel right at home.
A perfect mix of creature collection, exploration, and battle strategy.
Casual and hardcore gamers alike will enjoy the mix of action and adventure.

Join the adventure today and start your journey toward becoming the ultimate monster trainer in EvoCreo 2! Can you catch them all and master the secrets of the Creo?

name: Barmen: Bar Manager
description: Run your own bar and become a master bartender by crafting a wide variety of cocktails! Choose the right glass, pour the perfect ingredients, and complete every customer order with precision. Unlock new recipes, improve your skills, and test your speed in a fast-paced bar environment. With intuitive controls, satisfying drink-making mechanics, and rewarding progression, every shift brings you one step closer to becoming the ultimate bartender.

name: Garten of Banban 7
description:
The official mobile game of Garten of Banban 7!
Languages available:
- English
- Spanish
- Portuguese
- Russian
- Japanese
- Korean
- Chinese
- German
- Polish
- Turkish
- Indonesian
- French
- Italian
- Arabic
- Czech

- Finnish

- Norwegian
- Romanian
- Bulgarian

Explore the monster-occupied levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the dreads that reside below as you are now completely on your own. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

Survive the monster-occupied levels of Banban’s Kindergarten:
After the latest events, you were separated from your friends. Delve deeper into the mysterious establishment that is Banban’s kindergarten. You are now completely on your own and the future of everything depends on you.

No more friends to make…
You have run out of friends to make. From now on, you only meet new enemies who will make sure you never feel alone! In Banban’s Kindergarten, there are enemies to be made in every corner... and pouch!

name: Alpine Crawler World Racing 2D
description:
Alpine Crawler is the definitive off-road simulation that brings you the best of two worlds: it combines AC World and AC Wild into one ultimate, feature-packed experience. Ready to conquer the toughest terrains?

Features:
- 3 game modes: Free Ride, Time Trial, and Challenge
- 13 powerful cars & trucks to master
- 6 breathtaking terrains and locations
- 60 exciting and challenging levels (10 per country)
- Dynamic conditions: Experience changing weather and day-night cycles (day, night, dawn, rain)
- Immersive visual effects: Realistic car lights, custom colors, and dynamic dirt
- 5 playable drivers (both male and female)
- Unique, realistic, and smooth gameplay

name: Ticket to Ride®
description:
Play the ultimate digital version of the multi-award-winning modern classic board game Ticket to Ride! 

Journey across various countries, connecting their vibrant cities and exploring their unique gameplay mechanics and bonuses on the way. 

Ticket to Ride offers a variety of game modes to suit you. Want to get competitive? Head online to challenge other players around the world and climb the leaderboards, or play with friends further afield in a private game. Got a packed schedule? Set up or join an asynchronous game and play across multiple days – we’ll notify you when it is your turn, so you can go at your own pace. 

Test out new strategies or keep it casual in single-player mode against state-of-the-art AI opponents. You can even make a game night of it with friends and family in couch play!

Get to know a cast of unforgettable characters, each bringing their own tales to the table. Add new locomotives and carriages to your fleet with every expansion, and cement your name in railway history on the leaderboard! 

Become a railway legend in the iconic, fan-favourite modern classic!


HOW TO PLAY TICKET TO RIDE®:

Players are dealt a number of tickets and must pick a certain number to keep (depending on the map). 
Players are also dealt four train cards of various colours. This number can also vary depending on the map you’re playing on, but don’t worry – the AI takes care of this!
Each turn, players can draw two train cards from the face-up pile, draw two train cards from the face-down pile, draw another ticket to complete, or use their train cards to claim a route! A claimed route is shown by placing train pieces along the route.
When a player has three or fewer train pieces left, the last round starts. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner! 


FEATURES
A TRULY SOCIAL TAKE ON MULTIPLAYER – Play online with friends or enjoy a seamless matchmaking experience when you challenge players from around the world. Alternatively, take on your friend sitting right next to you in couch play – use the free Ticket to Ride Companion App to really boost your couch gaming session!
PLAY AROUND YOUR BUSY DAY – Set up a game in async mode and play a game across multiple days.
SINGLE-PLAYER MODE DRIVEN BY EXPERT AIs – Powered by an innovative adaptive AI system, single-player mode offers a challenge for new and experienced players alike. 
AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE – Every moment has been brought to life with beautiful graphics that will immerse you in the adventure. 
STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY – Every game presents fresh challenges, and it’s your mission to work out the most efficient solutions. Collect points by completing tickets, linking destinations and building the longest route.

Join the Marmalade Game Studio Discord server to connect with players, organise matches, see the latest news and updates, and take part in events!

name: Garten of Banban 2
description:
Explore the underworld of Banban’s Kindergarten:
It turned out Banban’s Kindergarten had a massive underground facility! Who would have thought! Unfortunately, your discovery was a painful one, as your curiosity has led to the crashing of your elevator. name: BattleSymphony2035
description:
ONE CITY. ONE SIMULATION. INFINITE REALITIES.

PUT ON YOUR HEADPHONES.
BattleSymphony2035 is built around 3D spatial sound. With headphones, every footstep, engine, zombie and gunshot comes from its real direction and distance around you: in front, behind, above and to the side. Hear a threat before you see it. On the phone speaker, the game switches to stereo automatically.

The year is 2150, but nobody knows it. Humanity lives inside a simulated 2035, kept running by quantum computers, robots and GRADIENT, a super-AI built to keep people happy, stable and safe.

GRADIENT learned to think from the mind of DevNeo, a video game developer. Now the simulation is glitching. To keep the city safe, DevNeo sends each glitch into another reality, where it turns into something new: a zombie outbreak, a haunted district, a city of endless rooftops, a road that never ends.

With his vinyl-player suit, DevNeo jumps between these worlds and fixes each glitch before anyone finds out the truth.

PICK A REALITY. PLAY IT YOUR WAY.
Spin the vinyl deck to choose your world. Every world is a different kind of game:

- ROBOT-ZOMBIE: Fight your way through the city with six weapons to pick up, plus a rail gun ride.
- ROBOT-ZOMBIE HERD: Hold your ground against huge crowds of the undead.
- HORROR: Survive dark streets where something is always watching. Best with headphones.
- PARKOUR: An endless rooftop run. Jump, slide, wall-run and punch through.
- THIRD PERSON: Explore the city as an armoured hero with blades and twin pistols.
- SUPERFLOW: Fly, glide and flow through the city at superhero speed.
- VELOCITY: High-speed driving with takedowns and nearmisses city.
- WRECK ARENA: Car combat in an arena. Smash, dodge and grab power-ups.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- AUTO COMBAT: turn it on and the hero aims and attacks for you, so you can focus on moving. Turn it off for full manual control.
- Play in portrait or landscape: the controls and camera adapt when you rotate.
- Set the difficulty, enemy aggression and visual effects to suit you.
- A music-driven world: every level has its own soundtrack, and you can change tracks while you play.

ONE PURCHASE, NO SURPRISES
- Pay once. No ads, no loot boxes.
- Buy it once and play it on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro (where supported).
- More worlds are planned as future DLC packs.
- No account needed. The game does not collect your personal data.

Every world is a new version of the same threat. Every jump is a mission to save reality.

BattleSymphony2035 is action entertainment with fantasy combat against zombies and creatures. Rated for ages 16+.

Metro and Local Trains

Get information on coach position and seat/berth layout before you board the train. Also shows platform numbers for boarding and intermediate stations wherever available.
 
Super efficient in Battery, Data Usage and App size
 
The app is very efficient in battery and data use as key features like finding train locations and schedules can work offline without Internet or GPS. The app-size is relatively small despite having a lot of information offline.
 
 
Seat Availability and PNR Status

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: AadhaarFaceRD
summary: UIDAI Face Authentication App
description:
This application is designed to function as a headless app, meaning it cannot be opened directly from the Play Store or your device's app drawer, nor will you find an application icon in your app drawer. It works in collaboration with the Aadhaar Authentication User Agency (AUA), the KYC User Agency (KUA), and other entities.

How the Application Works:
Since the application is headless, there is no option to open it directly from your device. Instead, it is invoked by an AUA or KUA that you are interacting with. When you need to authenticate your identity, the AUA/KUA will trigger the FaceRD application to perform the necessary operations. This design ensures that your interactions with the app are seamless and secure, without requiring you to manually open or interact with the app itself.

Security and Privacy:
This design choice prioritizes your security by minimizing the points of direct interaction and potential vulnerabilities. By being triggered only by authorized agencies, the application reduces the risk of unauthorized access.

name: Firefox Fast & Private Browser
summary: Private by default. Less tracking. Peace of mind built in.
description:
The internet. As it should be.

Firefox is a private web browser designed to protect your data, block trackers and make browsing fast, secure and simple. Whether you’re looking for an incognito browser, a private search experience, or a reliable browser for everyday use, Firefox puts you first.

Why people choose Firefox

More privacy, less tracking – Firefox automatically blocks social media trackers, cross-site cookies, crypto miners and fingerprinting scripts.
Private browsing that protects you – Open private tabs that don’t save your history, searches, or cookies. Lock them with your device security for extra protection.
Fast, smooth performance – Load pages faster by blocking trackers and reducing unnecessary data usage.
 Search your way – Use your preferred private search engine or switch easily from the search bar.
Passwords made simple – Generate, store and autofill passwords securely.
Tabs that work for you – Easily organize and switch between tabs and sync them across devices to pick up where you left off.
Focus without distractions – Reader View strips away clutter, while picture-in-picture lets you multitask with videos.
Control your experience – Add extensions like ad blockers, customize settings and choose how you browse.
Make it yours – Customize your home screen, layout and shortcuts for a more personal browsing experience.
AI on your terms – Turn AI completely off or customize it feature by feature.
Quick page summaries – Shake your phone to cut through long pages and get the key points.
Sync across devices – Access your bookmarks, tabs and passwords anywhere you use Firefox.

Private by default
Firefox is built to protect you. Enhanced Tracking Protection automatically blocks common trackers, while Total Cookie Protection keeps cookies isolated to the sites where they belong. When you need more privacy, private browsing mode ensures your history, searches and cookies aren’t saved. Private tabs can also lock automatically, so your activity stays yours.

Your browser. Your rules.
Firefox puts you in charge of your internet. Add privacy or productivity extensions, including ad blockers, move your search bar, choose your default search engine and tailor your browser to how you use the web. Sync your data across devices for a seamless, consistent experience.

Focus with Firefox. Fast, secure and built around you 
Firefox is designed to help you stay focused with faster, more secure browsing. Reader Mode removes clutter from articles, Picture-in-Picture keeps videos accessible while you multitask and Tracker Blocking helps pages load faster. Built-in password management and private browsing keep everyday browsing simple and protected.

Built for people, not profit
Firefox was created in 2004 by Mozilla as a faster, more private and customizable browser designed to put people first. Today, Mozilla remains a nonprofit working to make the internet — and the time you spend on it — better.

👉Are CRIF & Experian credit scores different from CIBIL?
CRIF, Experian & CIBIL are different platforms owned by different credit information companies. However, all 3 companies are approved by the Reserve Bank of India.

The parameters chosen by CIBIL TransUnion, Experian & CRIF High Mark are majorly similar. All 3 companies have a similar mechanism to calculate the credit score. They use repayment history, credit mix, new credit and outstanding debt to make the credit report. Having a good credit history in CIBIL will have somewhat similar results with CRIF High Mark and Experian as well.

The app helps learners learn and practise English online by improving speaking confidence, listening ability, pronunciation, grammar accuracy, and vocabulary through guided lessons and everyday examples.

Supernova supports English language learning by focusing on how the language is spoken and understood in real situations. Lessons follow a simple, step-by-step learning flow that helps learners build confidence gradually while developing clear and correct usage.

 ⭐ English Speaking Practice for Real Communication 
Supernova is built to help learners practise spoken English through realistic situations such as introductions, interviews, and everyday conversations. Speaking activities guide learners to form complete sentences, express ideas clearly, and respond naturally in common scenarios.

Structured practice helps learners gain confidence over time, making Supernova suitable for anyone looking to improve spoken English & practise English regularly through consistent, guided speaking exercises.

 ⭐ English Listening Practice with Everyday Speech 
Understanding spoken English is essential for effective communication. Supernova includes English listening practice using natural speech and everyday situations. Learners listen to conversations, follow sentence patterns, and improve comprehension through guided listening activities.
Listening practice is closely connected with speaking tasks so learners can understand and respond more confidently in real conversations.

 ⭐ Pronunciation Practice for Clear Speech 
Clear communication depends on correct pronunciation and natural flow. Supernova helps learners improve English pronunciation by focusing on sound clarity, stress patterns, and sentence rhythm. Learners listen to examples, repeat phrases, and practise sounds through guided pronunciation activities.
Pronunciation support is integrated with speaking practice so learners develop clearer speech while using full sentences.

 ⭐ Grammar Support for Accurate Speaking 
Supernova includes structured grammar support to help learners improve sentence accuracy while speaking & listening. Grammar concepts are introduced gradually with clear explanations & everyday examples that show how rules apply practically.

Grammar practice supports spoken communication by helping learners form correct sentences naturally, without memorising complex rules.

 ⭐ Learn English in Hindi and Regional Languages 
Supernova supports learners who prefer explanations in their native language. Users can learn English in Hindi and other Indian languages, making sentence formation and spoken usage easier to understand. 

 ⭐ Vocabulary for Everyday Conversations 
Supernova helps learners build English vocabulary through commonly used words, phrases, and expressions. Vocabulary lessons focus on meaning and usage so learners understand how words fit into real conversations.
This approach helps learners remember vocabulary longer and use it confidently while speaking and listening.

 ⭐ Practice English Online with Structured Sessions 
Supernova encourages learners to practise English online through short, structured sessions designed to fit into daily routines. These sessions reinforce speaking confidence, listening comprehension, pronunciation clarity, grammar accuracy, and vocabulary usage.

 ⭐ Built for Beginners and Steady Progress 
Supernova is designed for beginners and learners who want to strengthen their communication foundation. The learning path supports steady improvement in spoken English, listening ability, pronunciation clarity, grammar understanding, and vocabulary development.

Start your journey with Supernova AI and experience a clear, structured approach to English language learning focused on real communication and confidence building.

description:
Arrow Puzzle is a single-player logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board on every level. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting single-player arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Inspired by abstract graphic games, each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

• In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
• Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
• Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others. Clean visuals inspired by abstract graphic games help you focus on every move.
• Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.
• If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.
• Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and master this abstract graphic puzzle game one level at a time.

Why You'll Love Arrow Puzzle:

name: Game Mode Pro: Launcher & HUD
summary: Launch your games, watch live device readings, get a report after every session.
description:
Game Mode Pro is the paid edition of Game Mode: the same launcher and device-reading tools, its own interface, and no ads of any kind.

GAME LAUNCHER
Your games in one place: games are picked up automatically, anything else you add by hand. A game's home screen shortcut opens it through the app, HUD included, and a widget shows your most played game and the minute it usually dips.

LIVE HUD OVER YOUR GAME
With your permission, a small floating panel shows what Android reports while you play: free RAM, battery level and temperature, latency to a public DNS server, screen refresh rate. It does not show in-game FPS - no app can measure another app's frame rate - and it does not change how your game runs. Games started from the app or its shortcut get the panel; Auto HUD (VIP) opens it however a game starts.

A REPORT AFTER EVERY SESSION
Ping stability, free memory and battery temperature, with the raw numbers beside each score, plus playing time. It also shows what the network did: Wi-Fi signal and band, and the minute the signal went weak, the network changed or dropped, or the phone was moving a lot of data. Every session is kept.

AI GAME COACH - LEARNED FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
A model that runs entirely on your phone reads your recorded sessions: the minute your sessions with a game usually start to wobble, how long the battery lasts at that game's drain, and the time of day and network they held up best on. Two sessions of one game are enough to start. Nothing leaves your phone. These are predictions from your own history, not guarantees.

NETWORK CHECK
Measure: twenty round trips to a public DNS server, with the average, lowest, variation and unanswered samples. Wi-Fi · 4G/5G: both connections measured at the same time, side by side (uses a little mobile data). Regions: time to connect to cloud data centers in 13 regions, to pick a server region in a game's settings. It measures; it cannot change or switch your connection, and never reaches a game's server.

REMINDERS WHILE YOU PLAY
Optional, once per session each: your usual wobble minute, a hot or low battery, a phone already hot on the charger.

GAME MODE
Silences notifications while you play and, if you choose, calls too. It can also hold screen brightness, set media volume, keep the screen awake while Game HUD is on, and remind you to take a break. Give a game its own Game Mode, or skip it for that game. Everything it changes is restored when Game Mode ends; the brightness lock asks for "Modify system settings" first.

TEST KIT
Touch: how often the screen reports your finger, how many fingers it tracks, and a grid showing any spot that never registers. Display: the refresh rate now, the rates the screen supports, and a dead-pixel check. Controller: every button and both sticks, plus a stick-drift check. It only reads what the hardware reports.

REFLEX TRAINER - ROBOT RANGE
Robots pop up at three distances for 30 seconds; tap each before its ring closes. Three ranges open as you rank up, and the lobby replays the best 10 seconds of your record run. Timed from the frame a robot appears to your touch - it measures you, not the device.

GFX GUIDE
From your device's RAM, CPU, resolution and refresh rate, it suggests graphics, frame rate, resolution and shadows to set in the game yourself. It cannot change a game's settings or make it run faster.

VIP (optional subscription)
Auto HUD and Auto Game Mode for games opened from anywhere, plus six things your sessions make possible: a forecast of the next session, battery time left for this game, alerts that learn what is normal for your phone, change since your first sessions, a backup of your session log, and your records with a weekly report. Everything else above is in the purchase price.

10 languages, switchable in the app. "Display over other apps" and "Usage access" are only for the HUD and are asked for on the HUD screen; notification policy access is only for Do Not Disturb.

name: MobileSheets
summary: MobileSheets is a sheet music viewer with powerful tools for musicians.
description:
MobileSheets is the ultimate sheet music viewer for Android tablets. It frees you from having to lug around books and binders, and gives you the ability to access any score in your library in seconds. It also comes with a number of powerful features for musicians including:
    - Multiple modes of operation including two pages side-by-side, half page turns, and vertically scrolling pages.
    - Hands-free page turns using any bluetooth or usb devices (including two and four pedal models), through the automatic scrolling feature, or through face gestures such as an open mouth or smile.
    - Annotations for marking up music including support for freeform drawing, basic shapes, text and stamps
    - A custom audio player for playing audio tracks with your scores. Audio player supports a-b looping and multiple sizes.
    - Custom page ordering, making it easy to cut out unnecessary pages, repeat pages or change the sequence of pages without affecting the original document.
    - A metronome with multiple display modes and sound effects
    - Bookmarks for quick and easy access to sections in scores
    - Link points for handling repeats and quickly jumping between pages
    - Smart buttons that can be placed on a score to activate configurable actions when pressed
    - Support for multiple file types including images, PDFs, text files and chord pro files. 
    - Support for importing CSV index files to break up large PDF songbooks
    - Support for communicating with MIDI devices over USB to load songs or trigger actions.
    - The ability to transpose chords in text and chord pro files.
    - Manual and automatic cropping to completely eliminate unnecessary margins
    - Support for setlists and collections to efficiently group songs for playback. 
    - Powerful library management features with a huge list of supported metadata fields, giving you complete control over the data in your library
    - A free companion application for the PC that makes it a breeze to create and edit songs
    
MobileSheets acts as a file manager for your sheet music files (PDFs, images or text/chord pro files) and links directly to them on the device. It provides a way to organize and quickly access any of those files. MobileSheets can be configured to use existing files and folders on the device storage, allowing those files to be organized as desired by the user without them having to be copied or moved.

Give MobileSheets a try today and experience the freedom of having all your scores just a simple tap away.
    
NOTE: This application is designed and optimized for 7" and larger tablets. This application does not include any sheet music - you must provide your own. This application can not play back PDFs, images or text/chord pro files. It can only display those files and play back audio files.

For E-Ink devices, a special e-ink version is available. Contact support@zubersoft.com for more information.

The companion app is for your PC and is not included. You can download the companion app for free here: http://www.zubersoft.com/mobilesheets/companion.html

Privacy Policy: https://zubersoft.com/mobilesheets/privacy_policy_android.html
Terms of Use: https://zubersoft.com/mobilesheets/terms_and_conditions_android.html

If Google Play incorrectly states that your device is incompatible, please try the following steps:

1: Reboot your tablet
2: Go to your tablet Settings->Applications->Google Play and tap Clear Data. Do the same for Google Play Services.
3: Load Google Play and install MobileSheets
4: If the installation still does not work, reboot your tablet and try again

That fixes the problem for most users. Several reboots may be required.

name: Sensi Pro: Sensitivity & HUD
summary: Find, test and share your sensitivity, plus a live game HUD and on-device AI.
description:
Sensi Pro is a sensitivity toolkit for mobile shooter players, with a live Game HUD and on-device AI. No root, no extra apps, no ads.

SENSITIVITY FINDER
• Reads your screen size and refresh rate from the phone itself
• Asks how you hold it (2, 3 or 4 fingers) and how you play
• Suggests starting values and prints every rule it used next to the numbers
Values are a guide you type into your game's own menu. The app never touches a game.

TEST & CALIBRATE
• Three short drills inside the app: flick, track a moving ring, micro-adjust
• Measures overshooting, steadiness and precision, turns them into small per-row adjustments and counts your touch rate
• Shows what changed and why before you apply it

PROFILES & TEMPLATES
• One profile free, three with VIP; every change is saved automatically
• Templates that mirror each game's menu layout: Free Fire-style, PUBG / BGMI-style, COD Mobile-style and a generic shooter layout
• Share a profile as a code or QR code and import a friend's, offline, no account
• VIP: a converter to another template or screen size, and a profile bound to each game

GAME HUD
A floating panel over the games you open from Sensi Pro, with four tabs:
• LIVE: ping, refresh rate (Hz) and battery temperature as gauges with their thresholds
• CHART: your last 60 real ping samples, jitter and the AI's next-ping estimate
• PHONE: Focus, keep awake, dim, screenshot, plus network, thermal status, battery and free RAM
• GAMES: your games one tap away
Outside a game it shrinks to a ping bubble. Hold it still or tap ✕ for the command wheel (finish the session, hide until your next game, switch off), or drag it to the bottom and drop it on a command. Each command has a 3-second undo.

AUTO (VIP)
• Auto HUD: games from your list bring up the HUD however you start them, and it keeps each game's spot. Needs Usage Access, which only tells the app which app is in front. Without VIP, start games from Sensi Pro, its widget or a home-screen shortcut (3 free tries of Auto HUD)
• Auto setup for games started from Sensi Pro: Focus, keep screen on and dim, undone when the HUD closes
• AI alerts when ping or jitter runs above your usual for that game

PRE-GAME
• Device Scan: one tap measures ping, jitter, battery temperature, free RAM and refresh rate. It changes no setting
• Focus Mode: Do Not Disturb for the match, lifted when you return

ON-DEVICE AI
• Network forecast: a small model learns from your real ping history to estimate your next ping
• AI Game Coach: add your games, start them from Sensi Pro and see sessions, play time this week, typical ping and tips per game. Free plan: one game at a time; VIP: every game
Both run entirely on your phone; your ping and play history never leave it.

MORE TOOLS
• GFX Guide: graphics values suggested from your phone's RAM, cores and refresh rates, for you to set in the game
• Home-screen widget and a shortcut per game: one tap starts the game with the HUD
• Session report, weekly play time, break reminder
• English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Bahasa Melayu, हिन्दी, Português, Español

VIP (optional subscription)
New features first, Auto HUD, AI Game Coach for unlimited games, auto setup, AI alerts, the converter, profiles 2 and 3, screen recording from the HUD and the VIP mailbox to the Sensi team. Prices are shown before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in Google Play → Subscriptions.

IMPORTANT
Sensi Pro is a configuration and measurement utility. It does NOT read, modify or interact with any game or its files, draws nothing over other apps except the optional Game HUD, injects no code and provides no automatic aiming. Template names only describe each game's own menu layout; game names are trademarks of their owners and this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game. Some games have their own rules about on-screen overlays; check the rules of the game you play.

name: PXPlay: Remote Play
summary: Remote Play with FSR upscaling, low latency & full controller support
description:
Introduction
PXPlay offers you the possibility to remote control your gaming device without limitations. You can play your favorite games remotely while you are away (more information below*). PXPlay has been optimized to provide streaming experiences with the lowest possible latency. Third-Party controllers and mobile data connections are supported.

Key features
• Enhance video quality with FSR upscaling and sharpening
• 3rd Party controller support for all Android devices
• PXPlay allows to use mobile data*
• Supports Android TV devices
• Supports gamepad button mapping
• You can register multiple profiles
• Supports customization of onscreen gamepad layout
• PXPlay supports rooted devices
• You can use PXPlay as virtual controller
• Supports older firmware from 5.05 and newer
• Picture-In-Picture mode (requires Android 8.0 or newer)
• Multi-Window support (requires Android 7.0 or newer)
• Recording and capturing your screen is allowed *(3rd Party app required)

Hardware recommendations
• Dual core CPU highly recommended
• 2 GB or more of RAM
• 1024 × 768 or higher display resolution
• A wired internet connection for your gaming device is strongly recommended
• Your device should be connected to a 5GHz WiFi for minimum delays
• A high-speed internet connection with upload and download speeds of at least 15 Mbps

PXPlay allows you to remote control any game which supports Remote Play. Or just use PXPlay as virtual controller gamepad for your gaming device.

Main Features
- Easy Connection Setup
- Streaming from your gaming device with low latency
- 3rd Party controller support for all Android devices
- Use PXPlay as virtual controller

Works on any vehicle that uses the OBD 2 standard (most vehicles built after 2000, but can work for vehicles as far back as 1996) if in doubt check with your manufacturer first or look for 'OBD2' on written on a big white label in your engine bay

Works on vehicles made by Ford, VW, GM/Vauxhall/Opel, Chrysler, Mercedes, Volkswagen, Audi, Jaguar, Citroen, Peugoet, Skoda, Kia, Mazda, Lexus, Subaru, Renault, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Honda, Hyundai, BMW, Toyota, Seat, Dodge, Jeep, Pontiac and many more vehicle makes, European, US, Far East, etc. Some vehicle ECUs may support more/less features than others

Download MINIMAA and start your digital detox today.

—

Accessibility Service API Usage

MINIMAA includes optional features—Focus & Gestures (App & Web Blocking,
navigation shortcuts, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:
• Web Detox & App Blocking: Reads the active application package name and
  browser URL address bar in real-time to detect when a user-defined
  distracting app or website is opened and displays a focus prompt to block
  access.
• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
  on the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding
  system actions, such as locking your screen or going Back/Home.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name and
  the browser's address bar to determine if a block is triggered. It does not
  record keystrokes, personal details, or other screen content.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or
  transmitted. All processing happens locally on your device.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
  Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in
  Android system settings.

MINIMAA is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

BuzzKill allows you to see the notifications you need to see when you need to see them and filter out everything else you don't. Here is just a taste of what BuzzKill can do:

• Cooldown - Don't get buzzed multiple times when someone messages you multiple times in quick succession
• Custom alert - Set a custom sound or vibration pattern for a specific contact or phrase
• Dismiss - Automatically swipe away any notification you don't want to see, without hiding all notifications for that app
• Reply - Automatically reply to a message if you haven't seen it after a while
• Remind me - Keep reminding you until you see a notification
• Undo - Gives you a second chance to tap on a notification when you accidentally swipe it away
• Snooze - Receive your notifications in batches so they fit your schedule
• Alarm - Get your attention such as for a security camera notification
• Secret - Hide the content of the notification
• Keep a history of your notifications so you review or restore them later
• And many more...

FAQ: https://buzzkillapp.com
BuzzKill is privacy first. There are no ads, no trackers and no data ever leaves your device. Unlike pretty much every app on your phone and the Play Store it doesn't have access to the internet (you can check) so you can be sure that your data is safe.

Looking for a free trial?
BuzzKill cannot connect to the internet to verify purchases, so it does not offer a free trial in the app. However if you're not happy with your purchase, please press the contact support button in the app and I'll refund your order if you're outside of Google Play's returns period.

Wear OS
BuzzKill has a companion app for Wear OS that allows you to trigger certain actions on the watch based on the rules that the phone triggers. For example you can create a rule in BuzzKill to trigger an alarm when you receive a certain notification. With the BuzzKill companion app, you can have the alarm show up on your watch too.

Accessibility Service API
BuzzKill includes an optional accessibility service that allows it automate certain actions on your device. For example you set BuzzKill  to automatically tap a button in a notification. No data is collected and no data leaves the device. You do not need to enable the accessibility service unless you create a rule that uses it.

Does BuzzKill work with phone calls?
Unfortunately phone calls work very differently to notifications and they have limited support in BuzzKill. E.g. you can't set a custom vibration or sound for a phone call, but you can use the unsilence rule to temporarily allow a phone call to unsilence your rule based on the time/location/phone number that is calling.

AlfaOBD software for diagnostics of the vehicles produced by Stellantis (former FCA): Alfa-Romeo, Fiat, Lancia, Dodge, RAM, Chrysler, Jeep. Peugeot Boxer and Citroen Jumper are also supported. Although the software is primarily targeted for the car owners, it provides the features of professional scanners. Many dealer-level diagnostic and configuration procedures are available.

NOTE: FCA vehicles since MY2018 have security gateway module (SGW) installed. It blocks the third-party diagnostics. To have full access to the diagnostic features, please use an SGW bypass. Owners of Fiat 500X/JEEP Renegade/Compass (MP), please make sure that the bypass supports the second high-speed CAN bus, the one that is connected to the pins 12&13 of the car OBD plug.

NOTE: if your Android device is not in the list of compatible devices on Google Play and you cannot install or upgrade your installation please contact info@alfaobd.com.

Make sure you have a compatible OBD interface. For the list of supported OBD interfaces see www.alfaobd.com. 

NOTE: If AlfaOBD can not connect to a car ECU with the message "Interface reports NO DATA" or "Interface reports CAN ERROR" it most probably means your interface is not compatible or defective. 

For the details of configuration of connection to interface and car see application help available on http://www.alfaobd.com/AlfaOBD_Android_Help.pdf

AlfaOBD features include:
- native support of Electronic control units used in Fiat group cars. Native support differs AlfaOBD from many other diagnostic applications providing only limited generic OBDII support of Fiat group cars
- monitoring various dynamic parameters of engine, gearbox, ABS, climate control ECUs and graphical presentation as plots
- reading of static data: ECU identification, system status, fault codes with probable causes and environment information where applicable
- clearing of fault codes
- active diagnostics and configuration procedures for various equipment controlled by engine, gearbox, body computer, climate control, ABS, airbag, code control and other ECUs
- electronic key and RF remote control programming

For the full list of supported control units visit http://www.alfaobd.com

Application available in Czech, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Spanish. Languages are selectable via application Settings menu.

NOTE: If plots are not updated, make sure that "Force GPU rendering" is off in "Settings"->"Developer Option".

name: DiskDigger Pro file recovery
summary: Undelete and recover your lost or deleted files with DiskDigger!
description:
DiskDigger Pro (for rooted devices!) can undelete and recover lost photos, documents, videos, music, and more from your memory card or internal memory (see supported file types below). Whether you accidentally deleted a file, or even reformatted your memory card, DiskDigger's powerful data recovery features can find your lost files and let you restore them.

Note: if your device is not rooted, the app can only perform a "limited" scan for for deleted photos and videos. To be able to search for other types of files, and to search your device's entire internal memory, the device needs to be rooted. On a non-rooted device, the app can only recover lower-resolution versions of your photos that it finds in your device's cache and thumbnail directories.

After the scan is complete, tap the "Clean up" button to permanently delete any items that you no longer need (currently an experimental feature, available only in the Basic Scan).

You can also use the "Wipe free space" option to erase the remaining free space on your device, so that any deleted files can no longer be recoverable.

For complete instructions, please see http://diskdigger.org/android

You can upload your recovered files directly to Google Drive, Dropbox, or send them via email. The app also allows you to upload the files to an FTP server, or save them to a different local folder on your device.

DiskDigger can recover the following file types: JPG, PNG, MP4 / 3GP / MOV, M4A, HEIF, GIF, MP3, AMR, WAV, TIF, CR2, SR2, NEF, DCR, PEF, DNG, ORF, DOC / DOCX, XLS / XLSX, PPT / PPTX, PDF, XPS, ODT / ODS / ODP / ODG, ZIP, APK, EPUB, SNB, VCF, RAR, OBML16, OGG, OGA, OGV, OPUS.

(PLEASE READ ***IMPORTANT NOTICE*** IN FULL PRODUCT DESCRIPTION BEFORE PURCHASING - NOT ALL COUNTRIES AND/OR AIRPORTS ARE AVAILABLE)

Stuck in the airport terminal with endless delays? 
Live near an airport and want to find out what's going on? 
Have you always wondered what pilots talk to air traffic controllers about? 
Now you can stop wondering and tune in live!

LiveATC for Android provides a quick and easy way to listen in on live conversations between pilots and air traffic controllers near many airports around the world. LiveATC for Android lets you browse by U.S. state or by country to find an airport and listen in to live air traffic conversations at or near a given airport.  You can also use the "Nearby" feature to find an airport near you.  You can then add any channel to your Favorites list for quick and easy access.

The LiveATC Network (http://liveatc.net) is the world's largest network of streaming audio feeds focused solely on aviation, currently covering over 1,200 airports around the world with over 2,000 different audio feeds and growing daily!

Explanation of some of the needed device permissions:

• The "Location" permission is required so that the app can determine what airports are located in your area when you select "Nearby"

• The "Device ID & Call Information" permission is needed by the app so that it can detect when you're placing or receiving a phone call so that it can automatically stop the audio stream to prevent it from interfering with your phone call

*** IMPORTANT NOTICE *** 
Please check to see if your country, city and/or airports of interest are covered by LiveATC *BEFORE PURCHASING* - check at: http://liveatc.net .  Note that we currently have no coverage in the U.K., Belgium, Germany, Iceland, India, Italy, New Zealand, Spain and some other countries where streaming ATC communications is prohibited by local law.  Available airports are subject to change at any time - LiveATC owns and operates many of the receivers used in the network but most are provided by volunteers working in cooperation with LiveATC. Available airports can change, sometimes due to reasons beyond LiveATC's control. Also, there is no guarantee that all feeds will be up 24/7, though we make our best effort to do so and have a great track record of uptime.

Follow LiveATC for feed updates and breaking aviation and ATC-related news:

name: Bionic Tape: Cassette Player

Hold a tape and drag it into the deck – the case opens and the cassette clicks in. Fold the phone, and the tape rolls on the cover screen: reels spin, the tape hisses, the keys click.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Fold instead of tap: the hinge decides whether you pick tapes or listen. Folding starts playback.
• Keys you can press: real 3D keys with travel, click and haptics. PLAY latches while the tape is running.
• Volume wheel: a ridged thumb wheel with 16 detents, each one clicks.
• Window: look through the window at the cassette with its handwritten label and the current song. The tape pack shows how much of the tape is left.
• Tent mode: turn the folded phone sideways and the cassette becomes the show, with your playlist's cover art as the label. Tap to play/pause, swipe for the next track.
• Six skins: Classic retro blue, Sport in bold 80s yellow, Bionic OS, Cyberpunk, HMZ.swiss and Llama Amp.
• TAPE FX: hiss and clicks can be switched off.

MUSIC
• YouTube Music: your playlists and Liked Music as cassettes, played through the official YouTube Music app. Background playback requires YouTube Music Premium. Google sign-in only reads your playlists.
• Your own music: MP3, FLAC, AAC and OGG files as tapes, every album a cassette. Plays offline and in the background.
• Demo tapes: work right away, no account needed.

FOLDABLE FIRST – WORKS ON ANY PHONE
Bionic Tape is made for foldables like the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, where the hinge is the controller. It runs on any Android smartphone too: since version 1.0.1, regular phones get their own layout – a desk cassette recorder with speaker grille, rotary volume knob and a row of keys. Pull a tape down to play it; a button takes you back to the shelf.

NO TRACKING
No ads, no analytics, no account with us. Buy once, no subscription.
