Samsung Health can track your skin temperature automatically while you sleep. Body Temperature - Thermometer adds on-demand readings whenever you want one. Tap once on your watch and get your wrist skin temperature now.

🤝 SAMSUNG HEALTH PARTNER
Accepted into the Samsung Health Partner App Program — for authorized, reliable access to your watch's temperature sensor.

⌚ ON YOUR WATCH
- One-tap wrist skin temperature measurement, result in seconds
- The reading comes straight from your watch's own skin temperature sensor
- Tap the value to switch between Celsius and Fahrenheit
- Calibration with fixed or percentage-based adjustments
- Wear OS Tile for one-swipe access
- Watch face complication
- Fully standalone — works without your phone
- 8 light and dark themes to choose from

📱 ON YOUR PHONE — COMPANION APP INCLUDED
- History — every measurement, grouped by date, showing which device it came from
- Charts — Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly and All Time views
- Today summary — average, minimum, maximum and number of measurements
- Add a note to any reading, with quick tags: After sport, After sleep, After charging, Outdoors, Feeling sick
- See the raw sensor value and your calibrated value side by side
- Home screen widget with your latest reading
- Start a measurement on your watch from your phone
- Language selector

🔒 PRIVATE BY DESIGN — AND WE MEAN IT
- The app has no INTERNET permission at all. It cannot send your data anywhere, because it cannot reach the network.
- No account, no cloud, no sign-up
- Play Data safety: no data collected, no data shared with third parties
- Your watch and your phone talk over Bluetooth only

💜 ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Buy it once and keep it. No subscription, no ads, no in-app purchases, no upsells.

❓ QUICK ANSWERS
- Do I need my phone? No. The watch app is standalone. The phone app keeps your log, charts and widget.
- Can it detect fever or measure body temperature? No. It reads wrist skin temperature, which is normally lower than core body temperature.
- Galaxy Watch FE or a non-Samsung Wear OS watch? No. Watch FE has no skin temperature sensor, and the app reads the sensor through Samsung's own SDK, so it runs only on the models below.
- Why does my reading look low? That is normal for wrist skin temperature. The calibration setting lets you fine-tune how the value is shown.

🏃 WHEN PEOPLE USE IT
Before and after a workout, after a sauna or cold shower, while travelling, or to see how your wrist temperature changes through the day.

⌚ SUPPORTED WATCHES — PLEASE CHECK THIS LIST BEFORE BUYING
This app needs the infrared skin temperature sensor. It works on these models only:
Samsung Galaxy Watch 5
Samsung Galaxy Watch 5 Pro
Samsung Galaxy Watch 6

Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 Classic Astro Edition
Samsung Galaxy Watch 7
Samsung Galaxy Watch 8
Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 Classic
Samsung Galaxy Watch 9
Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra

Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2

Galaxy Watch FE is not supported — it does not have a skin temperature sensor. Non-Samsung Wear OS watches are not supported.

ℹ️ IMPORTANT
This app measures wrist skin temperature from your watch sensor. Wrist skin temperature is not the same as core or oral body temperature — indoors, a healthy wrist typically reads a few degrees lower than core temperature. This app is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent fever or any medical condition.

name: Leaf Spy Pro
summary: View detailed information about your Nissan Leaf the dealer never shows you.
description:
The Leaf Spy Pro application allows anyone with a Nissan Leaf electric vehicle, Android device with Bluetooth and a supported ELM327 OBDII Bluetooth adapter the ability to monitor their battery and other vehicle information normally visible only to the dealer. 

With the release of version 0.39.97 LeafSpy Pro now supports two Bluetooth 4.x LE approved adapters. The recommended one is the LELink available from Amazon. Bluetooth 4.x LE has the advantage of not needing to be paired and lower power from both the Android device and the Leaf. The LELink is highly recommended and also works with the iOS version of LeafSpy Pro.


The built-in help file is available as a PDF by sending an email with subject "Android PDF Help" to WattsLeft.meter@gmail.com 


Information displayed by Leaf Spy Lite & Leaf Spy:

* Voltage of each of the 96 cell pairs (highlighted if shunt active)
* Minimum, average, maximum cell pair voltages
* Histogram of cell pair voltages
* Battery Temperature readings (4 sensors for 2011/12 models, 3 for 2013 models)
* Battery AHr rating (this will decease with age and is an indication of remaining capacity)
* VIN
* Odometer
* Number of Quick Charge connections
* Number of L1/L2 Charge connections
* EVSE Max available amps
* EVSE voltage


Additional information displayed by Leaf Spy:
* Battery energy level in GIDs & kWh
* Resetable energy usage meter (Wh resolution)
* Graphic display of SOC, GIDs and DTE (Distance to Empty)
* Remaining distance meter (miles/km) to Event (Low Battery Warning, Very Low Battery Warning or Reserve) based on user selectable energy efficiency
* Graphic display of battery temperature with min, avg, max temperatures
* Tire Pressure of each of the four tires with low pressure warning and delta pressure warning alarm (at the moment only for 2011-2017 Leafs)
* Ambient Temperature
* Logging function that records most data and optionally GPS location to a csv file that can be easily imported into excel.


The "Pro" version adds the ability to perform functions normally requiring a visit to the dealer.
* Change automatic door lock/unlock settings
* Read Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC)
* Register Tire Positions (required after tire rotation or seasonal tire changes so your Leaf knows the correct location of each tire on the car)
* Ability to reset DTCs from selected ECUs
* Control VSP Sounds on 2013-2017 Leafs. (Nissan disabled this function on 2018 and newer Leafs.)
* Clear P3102 DTC after a battery replacement.

name: Kingshot
summary: The Ultimate Medieval Strategy Idle Game!
description:
Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.

When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.

[Core Features]

Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.

Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.

Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.

[Strategic Gameplay]

Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!

Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!

Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!

Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.

Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.

Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!

⚔️ BREAK EVERY WALL. RULE EVERY ARENA.

In Castle Busters, the battlefield falls apart one shot at a time. Every wall you destroy opens a new angle. Every floor you collapse exposes a rival. Who needs a front door anyway?

WHY PLAYERS LOVE CASTLE BUSTERS

🏰 Fully destructible castles. Smash through walls and bring down their towers. 

⚡ Turn-based 1v1 PvP. Fast online multiplayer matches packed with tactical decisions. Make every shot count because your rival gets the next one.

🏗️ Your castle. Your design. Build a castle worth showing off, then put it to the test against other players. Building yours is almost as satisfying as watching theirs collapse. 

🛡️ Build your loadout. Draft your units: brave knights, sharp-eyed archers and bombers who brought more than enough explosives. Combine their strengths, find powerful synergies, and leave your opponent shaking more than their towers.

📈 Upgrades that make a difference. Level up your units and strengthen your castle with new gadgets. Give your crew a stronger home and your opponent a harder job.

🏆 Battle through the arenas. Earn trophies, progress along Trophy Road, and unlock Ranked mode. Battle real players and climb the leaderboards for rewards and bragging rights.

🔥 The Forge. Earn epic rewards as you upgrade your squad and stronghold. Who knew you could get rewarded for being such a destructive influence?

🎯 Play your way. Pick off exposed units with precision or lay siege to their castle. Change your strategy as the walls come down and decide where the next shot will hurt most.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Take aim and fire. Your crew brought the firepower. Your opponent kindly supplied the target. Destroy their defenses to open up your next shot, expose their units, and make their castle collapse. They can't hide behind a wall you've already demolished.

Win by wiping out all enemy units or turning their castle into rubble. Every turn brings a choice: take out a hero or give their castle a window they didn't ask for.

DRAFT YOUR CREW

Some heroes bring the damage. Others rally the crew to hit even harder. And some bring teammates back from the dead because nobody said they could leave yet.

Mix and match units to build a loadout where their abilities work together. Plan around your favorites, experiment with different combinations, and find a crew that suits your playstyle.

RAISE YOUR GAME

Level up your units, unlock new heroes, and discover fresh tactical options as your crew grows. Your castle evolves too. Strengthen your walls and towers, try new gadgets and strategies, and put your build to the test in multiplayer PvP.

Progress through the arenas on Trophy Road, then climb the ranked ladder and clash with the best. You'll need to outthink your rivals, not just outshoot them. The view from the top is lovely. Expect incoming fire.

WHO IT'S FOR

If you love turn-based strategy games, 1v1 PvP duels, or fast online multiplayer battles, Castle Busters is built for you. Got a few minutes? That's plenty of time to make a mess of someone's castle. With physics-based artillery and walls that won't stay where you left them, it's impossible to play the same way twice.

The arena is open. Go break something.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

🎨 DISCOVER PIXEL ART
Complete hundreds of colorful levels with themes like animals 🐘, fruit 🍓, food 🍜, flowers 🌸, nature 🌿, festivals 🎉, toys 🧸, rockets 🚀, castles 🏰, and plenty more surprises.
